Democracy Docket: Louisiana Governor Signs Multiple Anti-Voter Bills and More Are Pending [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=072924_4&amount=25]
Louisiana's governor, Jeff Landry, has now signed eleven anti-voter bills into law in the last couple of weeks. He started the month off with these seven new suppressive laws:

body:
After Mark won in 2020, we had to go straight back into campaigning. He was up for re-election in 2022 for a full term in the U.S. Senate, and running two back-to-back campaigns isn’t easy.
#

Friends, we’ll be honest with you.
After Mark won in 2020, we had to go straight back into campaigning. He was up for re-election in 2022 for a full term in the U.S. Senate, and running two back-to-back campaigns isn’t easy.
We weren’t sure if we’d be able to raise what we needed to win after how expensive and tough the 2020 cycle was.
But thanks to the efforts of this team Mark won — not just in 2020, but again in 2022.
We’ve still got a ton of work to do, though. Whether that’s building and supporting teams that can win again in Arizona in 2024, helping out our friends in tough races around the country so we can hold the Senate and win back the House, fighting alongside Kamala Harris to defend the White House, or building the long-term infrastructure we need to win in the future.
This team never stopped working.
And one of the main ways we fund that work is through sustaining donations made by our top supporters. Recurring monthly donations make up almost half of our total fundraising every month, and it’s a critical pillar in our program. One we plan around each and every month.
Unfortunately, those sustaining donations have started to fall off. It’s straining our budget, and it could have larger impacts on what we’re able to do in this election cycle — and beyond.
You’ve been with us for a long time. And we were hoping that you might be able to commit to a sustaining, monthly donation. You’d be counted among Mark Kelly’s most dedicated supporters, and you would be giving him the ability to go all in as we fight for victory in Arizona and beyond in 2024.
So, how about it:
[**Can you join the thousands of others who make a monthly donation to Mark Kelly’s campaign? Use this link and make a recurring donation. It’d mean a lot to us, and to Mark.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/2349?c0=mek-em-july24.WYIUo5&refcode=em240729-2-450&t=1&akid=5826%2E6688874%2ETxQ6y8)

Thank you for considering it. This would be a huge help to us.
Team Kelly

| | Congressman Russell Fry, South Carolina’s Seventh Congressional District Congressman, is honored and humbled to represent the Pee Dee and Grand Strand areas in Washington, D.C. Russell Fry is the successful product of the American Dream. He learned from his parents that there is no such thing as a free lunch and that success comes from hard work and determination. Russell self-funded his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina and then earned his law degree at the Charleston School of Law. In law school, he served as Student Bar Association president, helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation, and received the prestigious Civility Award. For over a decade, he practiced law all along the Grand Strand. Russell has always been a public servant and an advocate for the conservative movement. Prior to his election to U.S. Congress, Russell Fry represented Horry County in the South Carolina General Assembly. As Chief Majority Whip in the State House, he fought to lower taxes, defend the unborn, and safeguard the 2nd Amendment. Additionally, Russell fought to put 18 policy initiatives into law in his time as Chairman of the SC House Opioid Abuse Prevention Study Committee. This legislation provided funding for education on opioids, opioid prevention, and opioid treatment. Russell and his wife, Bronwen, have one son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their beloved chocolate lab, Jasper.

name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
An update from a week where I walked in a parade, attended two county fairs, and joined an election integrity workshop with our grassroots activists. | | | | |
---
| We are 98 days away from Election Day. And it’s going to be a sprint to the finish.
Here’s an update from a busy week on the campaign trail.
**South Milwaukee Heritage Days Parade** I spent my Saturday morning in South Milwaukee at their annual Heritage Days parade. The parade caps off a week full of events that celebrate South Milwaukee.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
| We had a great crew walking with us and it was nice to see so many familiar faces in the crowd. Thanks to all of the volunteers in South Milwaukee for welcoming us and putting on a great event!
**Racine County Fair** This year was the 102nd Annual Racine County Fair and it did not disappoint.
---
| Whether it’s watching the livestock auction, working the cream puff tent, or getting to see so many familiar faces, I always look forward to the Racine County Fair and was glad to attend this weekend. We’ll see you there next year!
**Rock County Fair** I also stopped by the Rock County fair this weekend and got the chance to thank our hard-working volunteers who were out registering voters, signing up poll workers, and bringing our conservative message directly to voters.
---
| It was a great weekend to visit county fairs across the First District!
**Fighting For Election Integrity in Wisconsin** On Sunday afternoon, I spoke to our grassroots supporters in Elkhorn about the importance of ensuring our elections are secure.
---
| I’ve been working in Congress to develop policies that will make our elections secure and increase voters’ confidence. I’m thankful for all the work our grassroots activists are doing to protect the vote on the ground in Wisconsin.
If you want to get more information about the national effort to secure our elections, visit the link below.
---
[Click Here for More Information!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=bd9414e9f7&e=e907534017)

On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil

body:

Throughout pivotal moments in history, we have witnessed the remarkable transformation of seemingly lost causes, orchestrated by the savior generals--visionary leaders displaying unparalleled expertise.

Today, I'm pleased to share with you a free resource that will ignite your curiosity and challenge your perceptions. Esteemed historian and Hoover Senior Fellow, **Victor Davis Hanson** , has authored a groundbreaking eBook--_Victory and the Savior Generals_ --a captivating exploration into the minds of these exceptional leaders.

You can secure your free copy today by clicking on this exclusive link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zm92vnv524vdhqj3c910q0igl44ha894a3m6rbag_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cpj6cpr3cdh2bs)**

Inside its digital pages, you'll embark on a journey that uncovers the defining traits of these savior generals. Their ingenuity, contrarian spirit, and unwavering courage breathed new life into seemingly lost causes. Their profound understanding of conflict, rejection of complacency, adaptability to change, and alignment with societal values contributed to their monumental successes.

This is your opportunity to unravel the secrets of history's most influential leaders, unlocking invaluable lessons that resonate even in the present day.

Claim your complimentary copy of _Victory and the Savior Generals_ now through this secure link: **[https://resources.hoover.org/victory-and-the-savior-generals](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zs54g7ilg6urt5s70v844ilda1ic2bovjggal8ao_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cpj6cpr3cdh2bs)**

Wishing you a wonderful journey through the pages of history!

Greg

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Teaching the Ten Commandments to children
body:
In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers

Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?
| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zn8kes526oskji6kjp0vmlhgur72clkmf064eij0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cpj66pj6c9h2bs)
---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmthh3duffj6fc7c7dfb7c423giucpta4b404ns0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cpj66pj6c9h2bs)
---
| | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,_The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way_. This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zilloojteqeb07deahajejtvi64499rmnuo5quo0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cpj66pj6c9h2bs)

Your generosity enables _Pathway to Victory_ to share bold biblical truths with a broken world. Together, we will make a difference and bring people closer to Christ.

Thank you for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/OmNnXLwcUa0l7BBscT199Q~~/AARclAA~) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmgdh026mi2um2t1gjrk65gsime0ptvtm7udnbeo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cpj6eoj2c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zi1qtsf06rlu3croqgeuglnugu8rvimiiimldgog_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cpj6eoj2c9h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zb83biovs6hqdedp5stdi8bs9699e6n4sfd3etfo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cpj6eoj2c9h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

| Athens, GA - Protect Freedom PAC, a Rand Paul-affiliated Super PAC dedicated to supporting pro-liberty and freedom-minded candidates, announced that it will be running an independent campaign targeting Vice President Kamala Harris regarding her mishandling of the border crisis. The ad, titled "Chaos," will be backed by a six-figure ad buy to start and will be focused on swing states where the greatest impact can be made.
Mike Biundo, Protect Freedom PAC's Chairman, issued the following statement:
"Kamala Harris' ineptitude on the border has caused chaos in states and communities across America. She lied about how the border was secure when, in reality, she couldn't even find the time to visit. She wants to decriminalize illegal immigration, and she supports taxpayer-funded healthcare for illegals. Kamala Harris had one job, and all she produced for us was chaos."
To view the ad, please [click here](https://mgzelv8ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QZns2hxV341aKDhQHmNfs9og5d8ADOAjxrv48vu7ncj3LqNS3i_M_6Dg9Az7J-qIHvyhAd4d-jiCE_KgzkpqHgJCCrFdYGQxxxlKp7YjWJayLv03wjo95BxSaFzTtotpD1FINmh-b2IJSqgOyiruiSmAN-XvvDeTJmS3GYCUGOQgcdFiv_fRzw==&c=lw3T21u7srR6TtNLiAUzB64pa3Y1kYzubtSln2BcoR9kblo9SRCR1g==&ch=Y9Xqes1gpU21ZAxGulUiq7O_Z8pdbYjBB4q3FIz7griOkkiMb1mj7g==).

News Anchor: Vice President Kamala Harris, the so-called Border Czar.
Reporter: Do you plan to visit the border?
Kamala Harris: Not today.
VO: Kamala Harris had 4 years to keep illegals, criminals, and fentanyl out of America - but Kamala chose chaos.
Kamala Harris: Or a country of chaos...
VO: Protect Freedom PAC is responsible for the content of this advertising.

| |

Since 2018, Protect Freedom PAC has made expenditures totaling approximately $26 million. Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?

Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.

## Biden Urges Supreme Court Overhaul
President Biden on Monday [urged Congress to enact reforms](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAQQL8GNkfH-RJg8NAlW7p2RGf7LrgCjIyTqH9fpXPHp7c8va_bdOO0pO3-yau4qnniUNNTpt5YMEgTtdGpCIptxXU9oqXLeMZ2dui9evRwGVV60lEGJFALPkbCgWObHAIS9BY6gM6OJx5RIsMQVCkwDw2BxFRzOX3ntNVZdPnJTymnkNd2cXOt-9HYjwavDV553-R1vNUbSk1hkQavx2MvsooJ-VGqKaK5rManKJuZuZR0mFoe625UIw1qGQEtS-CBOu_PNmBHvSjYtri4v9KypOPSNwT3ldPyF1L_3_J0-BsAAP__NcBlnQ) that will overhaul the Supreme Court and to ratify a constitutional amendment that limits presidential immunity. Under Biden's proposed plans, [Supreme Court justices would be subjected](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQRb8Gd1jjARtTUGzjLttuaWE8xLOCEGES7_79U179uitd6Rzp_LmtN8-JH_ffPpNrsaw-NH7TaqQCiXrV3e4iEZLqyA0GUenJjtgdDqYpqDl4UpuC0Rqw4xzjPA5btHGbTccOATUYBQPAoGzvLdLuYQ4x6uD9LDTQzq3U_m_hRzsopv_lTbUPJXfJHa09T6F-CVwELtd19f4fl_PzClw-bIELmM-2ApeNd3rI8_WslEmG8qpNVoqlZtmoZpk4czsltYPDKUPZqatuf16cEp-TERru2XP6lrefU7wdfgUAAP__Rmxg0Q) to 18-year term limits and be held to a strict code of ethics. He also called for the removal of protections of presidents from federal criminal charges. Congressional leaders say there's [little chance](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LuO2zAQheGnoToK5IjWpWCRRp3TphQoamhPwItAji3k7QNvt8DWHw5w8P-5b3dHkfLjt0toOZTNeaY3bpMclASzme6wARFw6NDqCWAw43KD7mk1eOcxICqzO62M3sPi1Tjvt3nWk791ZEGBUdOgtFJ6WHq3AB5OzT4E452bhVF4EJfa_y2U-Ykh_itvrL0vqYv2yXw2MfwSsApYr-vq8-4zXu3jAtazRGLyTcDaXmfFhNKXV2UB604HZuldjPIbyYqh1NSkL7kx8YupZBdlpETc5FmxfZZMLkpKsvrs9Dgsk-qqPc6LYqQ2TsKoR3IUv37yz9XeFv4HAAD__4_Lc-M) that Biden's suggested reforms will gain traction over the opposition of the Republican majority in the House.
## France Hit by Sabotage Again
Fiber optic cables in several French regions [were cut on Monday night](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQRb8Gd1h4ICYuKF7jLq_d0prgIWaDIcIjo_z9Kltvd6UrHR2dr9tyw5hifvzHnRyHsqDneNJipVYSzGK61QUiIN2RGyyANuN0gW5zE604qHEkAD1dgtV-JK01Wo-jMebaRQcKjLJaDUoNeupxAlpRXX0IxiNehVG0Ri61_y4x80YhvctJtfdl75LbmF-H0P8EzALm1lrv891_TgHzBy1gVvazJwFzqJT9JpkS-bIfMhO3Up9yiyzvb3liXjHFY5cYmKqsGFPDt8R6lCyRGf3z6DfeU1fd-moxpXiMVhj12DGmXyX-O9Dp4CcAAP__6nVo8w) in what appears to be a coordinated act of sabotage, affecting multiple telecom operators. This incident follows [recent arson attacks](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7GO6yAQRb8GOiw84GAKite4y2u3tCYwJLOLg-Uge_P3K2-93ZWudI7Ox3W-Ihd-3v_jQqHlOmNsvNPslNEK7GxlCpkIyEgKvQMw9uIHkI-QvBmNvuSbHZPLNNDgovN2yH7sXR6i5AAarHZG91r3xnfogRLqMeZsI-IorKbErW7dZ-Vne1Au77rT1sW6yBIera0vYf4JmARMx3F0-M31db4CppMtYNLu3F7AlDd8RlKZb7SpujaOqpb3snJU2BrGL7mFtB5cCr8uTlh9X5DLr6v9Xb4H-AkAAP__44taRw) on France's high-speed rail networks, raising concerns about security threats during the Paris Olympic Games. While no group claimed responsibility for the act, Interior Minister Gerald Darmanin suggested that [far-left French anarchists](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn8N3ojOZ2yHgaELW7p2tM5wJLQELIxi5d9X7tztkz7pPel93ZYbxRTz_ZOebFooC7kWX7zMcgCJalGdN4EZeejY9DPioCY9Yvcwo-5nUL4PaiXWvfO8gtekxzCt0-ihiwYBFcwD9AD9oC-kkT3B1YWgHNFVKGAfW6mX7xJze3BI7_LienHl2SXzaG3bxfAh0Aq0-b2VvZ2XQHuCBVqYz60F2qPU5GXmYxdoQ1y5yrK16GTmdpT6s8ud1tLozl7GLEOl7Fig7arx2xFTivs0CwX3J8X052__13gZ_A0AAP__qLlhpw) might be linked to the train sabotage, though investigations are ongoing.
## List: Top Family-Friendly U.S. Cities
Charleston, South Carolina, has been ranked as the most family-friendly city in America, according to a [new study by Rustic Pathways](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszztuxCAQANDTQLfWMOBfQZFiXUTatCmtWWZYE-FPbGQrt4-UOhd40vt8jA9KOS2vD5rFl7iOFEo6ZWxvFm7oRqfZRxEUq8WbFtG6pq9RT94YttBFZNdZK9KIhGfdOAP8DBFqo5NHQAetBQNgbF9Rj8IEXYjRBaJOORBOZd2rrzUtZZKYf9ZT9iqss85-KmU7lH1TOCgcmApdO22b7BVfgZdqkaJwuH8f93eFg1E46N3zdqWc09G0ysFrppT_tPL_7fT4GwAA__8z61CN). The research analyzed 323 cities based on factors including affordability, safety, and available family activities. Florida emerged as a [particularly family-friendly state](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFztCAQgOFfgx0OLpx6BcXX2N3XpnT2YDk3QXGA0_HfZ5I69du883w85gdy5O31H1eyNaQZXeWD5kFqJcHMpvE2EAHphmw3AGjT32_QLHYcA5C63TxqPQRHGrUy49g_nx09B9M3bEGBUYNWnVKdvrd4B_KoRheCcYijMIo815Tbz8RbXSjEKx2UW5fWJtql1r0I_U_AJGA6z7OtuO4Y9p8uYCr17S-Zcfsq0kXCfGKlLENMmT3KQi5tXq6pVBlw5XjJkJk2Hy_puF6SN1kXku8iYGqy9fvJMXLpB2HUa0WOvx_1b5XDwncAAAD__y9QZ60), with three cities--Clearwater, Orlando, and Cape Coral--ranking in the top five.

body:
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us.

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b8707e0e13d14e199155c808bd66a646&_e=-gNG2bssMWLb9HZXPRq9dPrCmGwPE6U2JlttFNQx321DpSfK-4YnopU_Z9ta9_bkFM97BSMFZoKnwdX6lFzOwJzwx5knbVHJvlsNDm9BMujNqiLK8-BxHz3wtit5wIw1UrnHSrU8kR1rUYUFEu2PzEwMw9fcHBesDBzzueX76XgDYFt-NZXy8cvrkKNWjsP8OdyW6zT82Vn5VdNCMhMJNr9s2UTH-kA7wfWqIE7hMlAEFslhT12Gd9QFikgn5M0VbKYZI1rY5BZcnfWVyObjrjFigxSfGTLC90sDUKxj3DeSNe-fy0u8dQEi1yMGoqwF6TlMLO65IRGEfJh6P0-Hi0tlj-v2dUMA16TszSeSUgoYruh8c_1tWWIplg0QlNfa3dUyygLi38O4pMKC5JlEIqqQLCrddbPPM14vsl4RxVtkp2MV07T7w_0FS-QHJbrC) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **" The Second World Wars."**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. Best regards,

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 7/30/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Dear Friends,
As we enter the final days to support Protect Kids Colorado, your immediate help is crucial. They need to collect 125,000 signatures by July 31 to get Propositions 142 and 160 on the fall ballot—initiatives vital for informing parents about gender incongruence in schools and ensuring fairness in school sports. Please join me this Thursday at Wide Open Saloon in Sedalia from 4-6 p.m. to make your voice heard and help us reach our goal, or check out other locations [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
Thank you for your swift action and dedication to protecting our children. This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, July 30, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[‘We must protect our kids’: Lundberg calls for ‘all hands on deck’ to help get initiatives to the ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
The final days are winding down in an effort by Protect Kids Colorado to collect the signatures needed to get two initiatives on the fall ballot, former Sen. Kevin Lundberg wrote Monday in an email newsletter.
Protect Kids Colorado, a coalition of grassroots citizens, worked to push Proposition 142 and 160 through the process to reach the ballot, Lundberg said. Each initiative needs 125,000 valid signatures before Wednesday, July 31.
Following is the language of each measure:
* Prop. 142: Any public school representative who obtains information that a child enrolled in their public school is experiencing gender incongruence shall notify the child’s parents.
* Prop. 160: Only female students, based on their biological sex at birth, may participate on any team or in a sport or athletic event designated as being for females, women or girls.

“Now is the time, we must protect our kids, and we need all hands on deck immediately,” Lundberg wrote.
A list of places where Coloradans may sign the petition is available at [Protect Kids Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Among those is the Thursday, Aug. 1, event at Wide Open Saloon, 5607 U.S. 85 in Sedalia, from 4-6 p.m. which will culminate in the Protect Kids Colorado celebration at 6-8 p.m. concluding the effort. It marks the final event for volunteers to submit petition packets.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado Democrat Jason Crow named to U.S. House task force investigating Trump assassination attempt](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* U.S. Rep. Jason Crow of Colorado has been appointed as the lead Democrat on a bipartisan House task force to investigate the attempted assassination of former President Donald Trump.
* The task force, chaired by Republican U.S. Rep. Mike Kelly of Pennsylvania, is set to issue a final report by December 31, 2024.
* The House recently passed a resolution granting the task force the authority to issue subpoenas, emphasizing the panel's serious and urgent mandate.
* Crow, a decorated Army Ranger and veteran of Trump's first impeachment trial, has pledged to lead a thorough investigation, though some critics may question the effectiveness of such efforts to rectify security failures and prevent similar incidents.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[All but three of the 519 bills that became law in ’24 legislative session had Republican support, even the bad ones](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* In Colorado's 2024 legislative session, 99.4% of the 519 bills passed received bipartisan support, with only three bills lacking Republican votes, showcasing a high level of cooperation.
* Internal divisions appeared among House Democrats, with none supporting every bill, while the Senate displayed greater unanimity with 180 bills passed unanimously compared to 77 in the House.
* Key contentious bills included House Bill 1059, which established an independent commission for setting state elected officials' pay, and House Bill 1121, which created a right to repair electronic equipment, both facing some Democratic opposition.
* Senate Republicans generally supported more legislation than their House counterparts, focusing on the practical impacts of policies on their constituents.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[House GOP campaign arm names Colorado’s Jeff Hurd, Gabe Evans to ‘Young Guns’ program](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Jeff Hurd and Gabe Evans, Republican nominees for Colorado's 3rd and 8th Congressional districts, were added to the NRCC's Young Guns program, aimed at supporting strong GOP challengers.
* Both candidates are recognized for their strong fundraising and campaign organization, marking them as key players in competitive races, particularly the closely contested 8th district.
* Despite NRCC support, Hurd and Evans face substantial financial challenges, with their Democratic opponents holding significantly larger campaign funds ahead of the elections.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[House District 22 is now a three-candidate race in El Paso County](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Daniel Campaña has qualified to run in the Colorado House District 22 general election, bringing the total number of candidates to three after successfully submitting over 1,000 valid signatures.
* Campaña, running as an unaffiliated candidate, joins incumbent Republican Ken DeGraaf, who received 9,538 votes in a solo primary, and Democrat Michael Pierson, who garnered 4,635 votes in his unopposed primary.
* Each candidate emphasizes distinct campaign values: Campaña highlights non-partisanship, DeGraaf focuses on reducing government power and enhancing liberty, and Pierson advocates for equality and opportunity for all.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Hillman: ‘The Colorado Song’ recalls a better time and place](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [MARKHILLMAN.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_On this Colorado Day, I remember the 1970s when our local radio station would open its morning show by playing The Colorado Song: “If I had a wagon, I would go to Colorado,” praising a state known for “Rocky Mountain peaks, climbing up to the sky” and inhabited by “folks who are rugged and bold!”_ _
__One verse describes what was quintessential Colorado: “A uniting spiring they will find at the great Continental Divide.”_ _
__It’s a fun song, and I’ve taught it to my kids. But, I get a little choked up because it describes a Colorado which no longer exists._ _
__The “rugged and bold” Colorado elected both liberal Democrat Governor Dick Lamm and conservative Republican U.S. Sen. Bill Armstrong in 1978. Both received 58% of the vote, so nearly one of every six voters supported both Lamm and Armstrong, recognizing personal qualities regardless of political differences._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[‘We are in crisis mode’: After meeting is blocked, Republicans further discuss removal of chairman](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | JULY 28** []() _A who’s who of Colorado Republican Party leadership here Saturday was still unable to answer a pressing question: Are they a minority faction or a unified movement for change?_
**_[If the chairman were to be removed, who leads the Colorado GOP? These three say they can](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | JULY 28** _If the Central Committee were to clean house at Colorado Republican Party headquarters and remove all state officers, as has been proposed by a faction of the committee, who might assume leadership?_
__
**[Colorado GOP faces transparency issues amid critical race controversies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RMV STAFF | STATE | JULY 26** _Amidst ongoing internal conflicts and strategic disputes, the Colorado Republican Party faces significant challenges concerning transparency and the manner in which it communicates its support for certain electoral races._

## Majority of Texans Back School Choice

Gov. ## New Braunfels Is State's Most Family-Friendly City
New Braunfels ranked as [the most family-friendly city](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL1utDAQAJ_GdKD12vwVLr6G7r42JVrD-ljJGATOcbx9lOvTTTHFaL4e44MkSnr-p5VdfodtpCnLi8e2NFCiHW0xOw9zrwt2ukU0FqHBYnHeavZTQOgsedOE3rezNbaDHqjxiIU4BLTQGtBQN0ZX1FjPNXeTmbrApJUFniVvR5UXzvymM8R7e_FRTdtaRLfkvJ_K_FM4KByu66rW-6REKW9Jtl9J4RAl8JnvyAoHOrJMH0p8lf6g7xQ4nmWgVeJdhkM4zfEudV_3Xd3V1b7sxeHm_ZIY5WxaZeG5ksRPQP7jx8vhTwAAAP__hJlkWg) in Texas (and the eighth most family-friendly in the United States), according to a study by Rustic Pathways. subject: WisGOP Update 5.29.24
body:
No images? [Click here](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-e-mtdjro-didthutlhu-tt/) [](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-r/) **July 29, 2024** Friend -

The jig is up -- Joe Biden has officially ended his campaign for President. Despite the Democrat Party's attempts to spin his administration's record, the facts don't lie.
Read our latest update below!

-Team WisGOP | After months of hiding the mental acuity of President Joe Biden, the Democrat Party has been forced to change direction for the upcoming 2024 election. Biden has officially stepped down, and Vice President Kamala Harris has officially stepped into the role of nominee, despite there being no primary election. Despite being tied to the Biden Administration's disastrous term, Kamala's record speaks to inability to lead the nation. Here are just a few of her highlights as Attorney General, Senator, and Vice President:
* In 2021, President Biden tasked Vice President Harris with overseeing immigration policy and securing the Southern border. Three years later, it's safe to say that her oversight has facilitated the [largest border crisis](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-y/) in United States history. As hundreds of thousands of illegal immigrants poured into the United States, Kamala continued to assert that the Southern Border was [secure.](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-j/)
* Moreover, Harris [openly stated](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-t/) that she wants to decriminalize illegal border crossings.
* As Attorney General, Harris was incredibly [soft-on-crime,](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-i/) and in 2020, Kamala [praised](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-d/) the 'defund the police' movement and helped raise money for the [Minnesota Freedom Fund, ](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-h/)an organization that raised money to bail criminals out of jail.
* Kamala has also vowed to [ban fracking ](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-k/)and committed herself and her campaign to [Green New Deal ](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-u/)initiatives.
* In 2019, Harris also [supported ](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-o/)single-payer healthcare and Bernie Sanders' 'Medicare For All' policy.

While the Democrats are attempting to drum up enthusiasm for Vice President Harris, her [approval ratings](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-b/) and anti-American record disqualify her from the possibility of winning the 2024 presidential election.
---

Just one week ago, thousands of patriots gathered in Milwaukee to take part in the 2024 Republican National Convention. This historic event ushered in the [formal nomination ](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-a/)of Donald J. Trump as the presidential nominee of the Republican Party. A [multitude of speakers](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-f/) took the stage to remind voters of the Biden Administration's abysmal record and assure the change that is destined to come with the election of Donald Trump as the 47th President. Convention attendees also heard emotional testimonies from [Gold Star Afghanistan families, ](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-z/)[Michael Morin, ](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-v/)brother of Rachel Morin, a mother of five killed by an illegal immigrant, [Madeline Brame, ](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-e/)and [Anne Fudner.](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-s/) The week was a huge success, and we at the Republican Party of Wisconsin are more excited than ever for the months to come. Wisconsinites made their presence known at the Republican National Convention, emphasizing the importance of our state in the upcoming election! Both [Eric Hovde](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-g/) and [Senator Ron Johnson](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-w/) gave invigorating speeches, and convention goers were also blessed to hear from Wisconsinite and WWII veteran, [William Pekrul.](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-yd/) In true Wisconsin fashion, delegates from the Badger State proudly wore [cheeseheads](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-yh/) on the last day of the convention.
---

**In Case You Missed It**
**[WisGOP to Open New Hispanic Outreach Center in Milwaukee](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-yk/)**
On August 3rd, 2024, the Republican Party of Wisconsin will be opening a new Hispanic outreach center in Milwaukee. This office will serve as a hub for the state party, Republican National Committee, Trump campaign, and other state and local Republican campaigns.
**[WisGOP Statement on the 2024 Republican National Convention](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-yu/)**
"From the Little White Schoolhouse in Ripon to the Fiserv Forum in Milwaukee, Republicans look to Wisconsin when history calls. Thanks to both the hard work of so many in our state and the passion of the American people, Wisconsin delivered the greatest convention in the history of the Republican Party. We leave Milwaukee unified, inspired, and ready to save this country and Make America Great Again."
**[WisGOP Statement on President Biden Withdrawing from the 2024 Election](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-jl/)**
"Having already denied voters the chance to replace Joe Biden during the primaries, the Democrat Party is now subjecting the American people to chaos, uncertainty, and an incapacitated presidency. If Joe Biden is incapable of the rigors of running for reelection, then he cannot be trusted to fulfill the duties of his office. Everyone from Vice President Harris, Tammy Baldwin, and the Democrat establishment bears responsibility for enabling the vanity and self-delusion of the Bidens."
**[Prices Under Biden Are Too High](https://republicanpartyofwisconsin.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mtdjro-didthutlhu-jr/)**
Americans cannot afford Joe Biden and Kamala Harris' never-ending inflation nightmare.

subject: The American decline is by design
body:
The assassination attempt on President Trump was no accident.

| | | Dear Fellow Patriot, _Do you think the assassination attempt on President Trump is the logical conclusion of the radical rhetoric of the Leftists who are trying to plunge our country into chaos and destruction?_ Well, I do. The assassination attempt on President Trump was no accident. The radical Left has been smearing Donald Trump and any other politician who has stood in their way for decades. . . . Calling them racists, likening them to Hitler, and saying that if these leaders gain power, they'll become dangerous dictators. The Left is trying to weaponize their already mentally ill and deranged supporters and disconnect them further and further from reality. The Left wants to recreate the conditions of the late 19th century Russian Empire here in America to pave the way for their new Soviet Union. **[**Will you help me stop them?**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zq07vl14u4jmkjimmn3fnbdko2fokl4dkhq6sgeo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cpimcob0s3h2bs)** **_The American decline is by design. The violent rhetoric is by design._** The Left hates America, and they will do whatever it takes to see its downfall. None of this is by accident, Friend. The Leftists that have infiltrated our government paid lip service to "toning down the rhetoric" and saying violence has no place in our political system. . . But not 48 hours later they went straight back to declaring that a Trump-Vance ticket is a threat to "Our Democracy." _We can't let them get away with this. Our country depends on us fighting back._ Fellow Patriot, that's why I started the Freedom Center. That's why we run independent journalist through Front Page Magazine. That's why we document the connections and movements of the Left with "Discover the Networks." And it's why we publish books and pamphlets like Barack Obama's True Legacy or Beijing Biden, exposing their plans and who is really calling the shots. If we take the spotlight off the Left, they will lie . . . and lie . . . and lie some more. They'll do anything to separate themselves from their past actions and escape accountability for the terrible things they've done and said to ruin our country and the lives of anyone who stands for it. **_A snake is most dangerous when it's cornered, and that's exactly how the Left in America feels today._** **[**If you believe America is worth fighting for, will you support the David Horowitz Freedom Center today as we stand ready for whatever the radical Left throws at us next?**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z6at799dss3kfkrg3jo5c4b5uapkal723ksqtfh0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cpimcob0s3h2bs)** I've dedicated my entire life to exposing the agenda of the radical Left through the work of the David Horowitz Freedom Center. Because I too once fell prey to their lies and deception-- When I was a young man, about 50 years ago, I got sucked into the Marxist revolution and was one of the leaders bent on destroying all that makes America great. Regrettably, I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. . . . I edited _Ramparts_ , the radical Left's largest magazine. . . . I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. Through these horrible events, my eyes were opened to the incredible destruction and evil that my "comrades" on the Left were responsible for. So, thanks to God, I cut all ties and never looked back! **I proudly cast my ballot for Ronald Reagan in 1984.** **Then I founded the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I've dedicated the last 40 years of my life to exposing their evil agenda.** _Why would I do that?_ Because, friend, I saw first-hand the threat the radical Left was to our country. I saw their evil beginnings and I knew if patriotic Americans stood by and did nothing, our country would soon be lost forever. **[**So, if you want to join me and expose the radical Left for what they are, will you join me in this mission with a donation of any amount to the David Horowitz Freedom Center today?**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z52ciia87mdig6jd0srg68lj9egep9hi1p34qoh0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj2cpimcob0s3h2bs)** Patriot, this fight won't be won if good Americans like you sit on the sidelines. Because the Left has way too many mobilized activists. I need every hard-working American patriot like you on my side.

Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

### **Living in interesting times**
The past two weeks in U.S. politics have been as tumultuous as the drama presented by the Olympic games. Biden's exit from the presidential race breathed new life into a [moribund election](https://substack.com/redirect/c748887d-0f12-4314-96d0-6c69d444c734?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), just after an attempt on Trump's life had seemed to [likely seal the outcome](https://substack.com/redirect/c0cac40a-0495-4e00-89e1-6d9e8761d3f9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in November.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0282362e-330e-4e41-a6d2-745d49670920?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A closer look, however, reveals that Biden's exit changed a lot less than most people seem to think. There are important distinctions to be drawn between Biden and Harris, but they are cut from the same political cloth and demonstrated similar approaches both to serving Wall Street and also supporting the [policing-prison-slave labor-industrial complex](https://substack.com/redirect/10a490e2-ff66-491a-b6eb-85a6b1f7c55b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
On the other hand, other Democratic party leaders revealed a great deal through their statements preceding Biden's exit, as well as their ensuing reactions. The significance of their changing stances, however, has been largely lost on most observers.

### **Behind the scenes: progressives fall for a head-fake**
In the days before Biden withdrew from the presidential race last weekend, a series of ironic voices emerged to defend his candidacy. Figures who invited fellow Democrats to put their divisions behind them and rally behind Biden--despite his frailty, mounting electoral vulnerabilities, and seeming hubris--included two of his ideological nemeses: Senator [Bernie Sanders](https://substack.com/redirect/cf27aa9f-8a03-47ea-a071-358872973911?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and Rep. [Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez](https://substack.com/redirect/2a02b670-49d6-4b7d-8298-e1b70a9e525c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
This, even after AOC explained years ago on national television that, "In any other country, Joe Biden and I would [not be in the same party](https://substack.com/redirect/8e60c626-96f6-4163-ac9a-1b46d2b2a728?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." She was right at the time. Biden is a lifelong conservative brought to the White House in 2008 to check and balance what some within the Democratic Party feared at the time would be a progressive inclination within the Obama administration.
On the one hand, reports have emerged that Sanders and Ocasio-Cortez pushed Biden for important [policy concessions](https://substack.com/redirect/c56389c0-862b-4f75-bb1c-ceb25752858f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) before choosing to endorse his re-election. For instance, they secured Biden's support for [caps on rent increases](https://substack.com/redirect/82a037f3-7c66-468c-90af-156914bd9361?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and urged him to embrace proposals to eliminate medical debt. Their bargain--supporting Biden in exchange for him supporting policies they have encouraged--would demonstrate a measure of political savvy, had he not proceeded to drop out of the race mere days later.
By endorsing Biden prematurely and inviting Democrats to abandon a necessary public debate, AOC and Bernie each sacrificed their stated principles, while playing an inside game and making a bad public bet.
They each got rolled by the party, demonstrating allegiance to Biden while abandoning the public debate for their vision and appearing oblivious to Biden's political frailties. It's the same pattern apparent when [Bernie campaigned for Biden](https://substack.com/redirect/b5eb7f64-7189-47f7-b7eb-350505bb4a24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in 2020 even after the insider machinations that led the many centrists to drop out and consolidate support behind Biden in order to deny Bernie the nomination. It's the same pattern that AOC later showed when [deferring](https://substack.com/redirect/f4802c59-776e-45a4-a70a-38731a63b10b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Nancy Pelosi despite having [led a sit-in at Pelosi's office](https://substack.com/redirect/d6beb9be-07dd-4803-8e92-797a0590b1b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on her first day in Congress to build support for the Green New Deal.

### **Behind the scenes: centrists reveal crass motives**
Meanwhile, Nancy Pelosi--representing very much the opposite wing of the Democratic Party--took a very different course.
Pelosi's dedication to Wall Street is both renowned and largely unrivaled. Over the course of her career, only a few Democrats have done as much as she has to support corporate America. One of them is Joe Biden.
Yet Pelosi seemed to abandon her conservative principles embodied in Biden by playing a reportedly key role in pushing him out of the race.
Why?
Pelosi's allegiance to the Democratic caucus in Congress certainly helped fuel her decision. With Biden at the top of the ticket, dozens of Democrats in the House and Senate would have been vulnerable in the November elections.
The biggest hole in that bucket is that putting Harris at the top of the ticket may help, but not likely much. Remember: Kamala Harris ran for president in 2020, but did not win a single state primary. Her home state [preferred](https://substack.com/redirect/99b591b7-f5d3-4a36-bb6e-42072f4f8ce5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Bernie Sanders by a vast margin.
On the other hand, her emergence as the likely candidate has certainly encouraged the party's grassroots activists, as well as its ranks of major donors. The impact of that new enthusiasm will reveal itself in time. Given how despondent Democrats had grown in the days before Biden's announcement to end his re-election campaign, there was nowhere to go but up.
Another hole in that bucket, however, has gone largely unobserved: Pelosi's own political network. By exhorting Biden to drop out of the race, she may have played the party like a fiddle.
Helping to push Biden out of the race may have reflected Pelosi choosing to put her political network before her legislative objectives. Like Pelosi, Biden is far more conservative than Harris.
But Pelosi was pivotal when Harris won her senate seat, as well as the vice presidential nomination. They come from the same city, where Pelosi was already a national power broker when Harris was first seeking statewide office. That's also why Gavin Newsom was never going to challenge Harris despite the media frenzy surrounding the possibility, and immediately chose to endorse her after Biden dropped out of the race.

We are at a key point in our history. We **must** defend our nation's founding documents and principles of liberty through education. And that's why I'm emailing you today.

Can I explain something, folks?
I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents.
**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.
I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.
**And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do.**

I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. = Can I explain something, folks? I grew up in a twenty-four-by-thirty-six foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and like my grandparents. In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer. Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive. I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand. The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy—but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded. And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hard-working folks like you to power everything we do. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Thank you so much for sticking by me. #

Peter, it’s Ruben.
Today is our primary. Tomorrow, the general election begins.
Back when I was first thinking about launching this campaign I had no idea what to expect.
I knew some friends would have my back. I knew some of the guys I served with in the Marines would stick with me. And I knew we had some core supporters from my congressional campaigns who would follow me to this one.
But beyond that, I had no idea.
Now, with the polls closing for this primary at 7 o’clock tonight in Arizona, I’m amazed at what we’ve accomplished.
I can’t believe that we’ve had a quarter million people from coast to coast chip in and power this campaign. A quarter million people sending in $5 here or $10 there as an act of hope — hope that we can still improve things in this country, and that we can win in Arizona.
We’re going toe-to-toe with Kari Lake, Donald Trump, and the entire MAGA-right. And we’re not just holding our own... we’re in a strong position to beat them.
And looking back, I never would’ve thought I’d need to ask people like you to do more than you already have, Peter. But to win, that’s what I need to do.
So, before our primary ends tonight, I’ve got to humbly ask you:

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
| Tammy’s facing her most competitive and most expensive reelection yet.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=3167%2E35263%2EpGg6o9)
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jul24.e1aXEk&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240730_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=3167%2E35263%2EpGg6o9) Hi Peter, Senator Cory Booker here! I wanted to take a moment to reach out to you about my good friend and colleague, Tammy Baldwin. Tammy has spent her career fighting for folks in Wisconsin and across the country — from lowering costs for working families and increasing access to quality, affordable health care, to fighting to restore and protect abortion rights. After campaigning with Tammy in her home state in July, I can say firsthand that Wisconsinites are fired up to send her back to the Senate. **But she’s facing her most competitive — and most expensive — reelection yet.** Tammy’s Republican opponent, Eric Hovde, is self-funding a campaign to flip her seat red — and so far, all signs indicate that his strategy is working. # Help River Conquer Pikes Peak and Our Campaign Goals!

---
|
In our district, we run up mountains, and the Pikes Peak Ascent is a race that show cases our resilience. Support us as I train of the Pikes Peak Ascent, and run Pikes Peak 3-2-1s.
What are Pikes Peak 3-2-1s?:In training for the Pikes Peak Ascent, it becomes critical to cope with elevation. The last three miles are above tree line, climbing from about 11,000' to 14,110 feet.
The world famous Pikes Peak 3-2-1s are a high altitude workout runners from all over the state, and even outside the US, come here to our district to do.
As described in a 'Marathon Handbook' article written by Adam Rabo, "For the workout, you drive to the top of the mountain to start. You run 3 miles down, 3 miles up, 2 miles down, 2 miles up, 1 mile down, 1 mile up. 12 miles total, all above 11,000 ft."
While our election takes place in November, we also prepare for this race up Pikes Peak, taking place in September. So I am taking part in a few of these Pikes Peak 3-2-1s, and wish to share that experience with you.
This last Sunday I completed my first full 3-2-1 of the summer, and I plan to complete them again on August 11th, and August 25th, and September 8th!
The race itself is on September 21st.
Climb with us and support our campaign, as well as the race to the top this summer!
Donate along side our training. [**With $100 climbing by each 3-2-1 completed.**](https://rivergassenforcongress.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7f5669b9b38d0a59e26b798&id=d35db2cf51&e=3818d77efc)
Sponsor this effort, and we’ll keep you updated throughout the training schedule.
With heartfelt thanks,River Gassen

body:
Discover the dedication and integrity that defines Eric Burlison
Peter
,

We deeply appreciate your support for Congressman Eric Burlison and his unwavering dedication and integrity.

Eric Burlison is a proud sixth-generation Missourian deeply rooted in our state’s rich heritage. As a dedicated public servant, devoted family man, and active community member, Eric embodies the values that make Missouri and America great.

Eric’s commitment to our constitutional rights and Christian family values shines through in every aspect of his life. In his free time, he enjoys hunting and fishing in the beautiful Ozarks, embracing the freedom and natural beauty of our state.

Eric and his wife, Angie, are active church members, passionately supporting campus ministries and fostering a sense of community. They reside in Ozark with their two daughters, Reese and Aubrey, instilling in them the same love for our country and its values.

Eric Burlison is more than just a Congressman; he is a patriot ready to stand up for the freedoms we hold dear. His dedication to conservative principles and his inspiring vision for a brighter future for Missouri and America are unwavering.

name: Senators Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown
subject: we’ve got less than 100 days
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here.
#
Hi Derek,
Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re reaching out today because we’re less than **100 days** away from the most competitive election of our lives in the two most competitive Senate campaigns in the country.
And we need your help.
Montana and Ohio are the only battleground states in the country that won’t see a lot of spending from the top of the ticket. You see, we’re a little different. We’re not the typical politicians you’d expect to see every day in the Senate. One of us is a seven-fingered dirt farmer. The other has been called disheveled, wrinkled, and rumpled. Neither of us are winning any best dressed awards anytime soon.
**But the thing that really sets us apart? We’ll work with anyone to get the job done for our constituents.** And we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home.
But our multi-millionaire opponents are trying to buy our Senate seats. Together, we’re going to send them a message: Montana and Ohio are NOT for sale.
We can’t write our campaigns million dollar checks. But we’ve got something better: You. Our supporters are teachers, electricians, farmers, autoworkers, you name it — who work hard every day to make a living and together, we can make a difference.
We’re building the largest on-the-ground grassroots campaign either state has ever seen because we won’t win this race unless we knock every door and talk to every voter.
**[That’s why we’ve set a rapid response Big Sky Buckeye Fund goal to raise $500,000 in the next 48 hours. So we’re personally asking: Will you chip in $10 to split between our campaigns and John Fetterman to power us through to Election Day?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240730?refcode=em20240730-9247&refcode2=9247_434096_1pQsXr&akid=9247%2E434096%2E1pQsXr)**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240730?amount=5&refcode=em20240730-9247&refcode2=9247_434096_1pQsXr&akid=9247%2E434096%2E1pQsXr)**
The next 100 days will be the most important and toughest so far. But that’s what it’s going to take to send this seven-fingered dirt farmer and disheveled champion for the Dignity of Work back to the Senate.
Thanks for having our backs. We won’t let you down.
—Jon Tester & Sherrod Brown

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20240730-9247-footer&t=1&refcode2=9247_434096_1pQsXr&akid=9247%2E434096%2E1pQsXr)**

subject: Are you ready for the end times?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vW6ZQcEWNR
Take a moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans
1:25 - trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly
things rather than our Creator.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW6ZQcEWNR

Hello
Friend,

Take a
moment to look around. It's like we're living out Romans 1:25 -
trading the truth of God for a lie and focusing on earthly things
rather than our Creator.

Have you
ever wondered if things could return to God's original plan?

I want to
remind you, Friend, that this chaotic time is fleeting. The
shadows will fade, and a new day will dawn. The King of Kings,
our Savior, will return.

That's
the heart of Revelation.

Each day
on this earth shapes us for what's to come - a grand finale.
Amidst today's messiness and uncertainty, remember the promise
that our story's end is already secured, regardless of the
present turmoil or future darkness.

Revelation intricately unveils where our stories lead.

It's a
captivating book filled with symbols, creatures, and events yet
to unfold. But remember Revelation 1:3 - there's a blessing for
those who read, listen, and follow its words because the time is
near.

This
isn't just a prophecy; it's a blessing-filled journey.

Revelation isn't just about revealing future events; it's about
revealing Jesus Christ.

When
Jesus came as a man, His divine brilliance was veiled by
humanity. It's like dimming a lamp's light. But when He returns,
that veil will lift, and we'll see His true glory. That's
Revelation's essence.

As the
great reveal approaches, I'm here to guide you and your loved
ones through the remarkable events preceding the revelation of
our King.

In my
brand-new book, Mysteries of the End Times: 5 Truths About God's
Future Plans, I tackle five common questions about the end times.
We'll delve into:

1.
America's Fate: Will America stand for Christ or fall for the
Antichrist?
2. The
Day of the Lord: How should we live in anticipation of this
apocalyptic event?
3. The
Marriage of the Lamb: What unfolds before and after the rapture?
4. Gog
and Magog: How can we honor God in our lives amid their
appearance?
5. The
Tree of Life: What's the significance of this tree in the New
Jerusalem?

Understanding these mysteries will anchor you in hope, bolster
your trust in God's promises, and equip you to share with the
unsure.

In
addition to this new book, I would like to share with you "The
Major Characters of the End Times," as a token of my gratitude
for your support. This full-color, large print booklet introduces
key players during the rapture, tribulation, second coming, and
final judgment - vital for understanding the grand narrative.

I would
like to send you my brand-new book Mysteries of the End Times: 5
Truths About God's Future Plans and my brand-new resource "The
Major Characters of the End Times' as a thank you for your
generous support of $10 or more to the ministry of Pathway to
Victory.

Make your
generous gift here:
https://secure.ptv.org/mysteries-of-the-end-times-generous-gift-1-dr-robert-jeffress

Pathway
to Victory is committed to equipping believers with biblical
teaching and reaching the unsaved by spreading the Good News of
Jesus Christ through the most effective means available: radio,
television, digital, and print. Your gifts fuel that important
work and enable people worldwide to experience an intimate walk
with Christ. Thank you for your faithful support.

May our
study of Revelation prepare, strengthen, and inspire you. Come
quickly, Lord Jesus.

Sharing
the Truth of God's Word,

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](https://click.gopactionalert.com/u/click?_t=093aa899b2bd42648f5b5caa6c6024d8&_m=a9aff592d67746a6911920d933bdc36f&_e=fggaIKrh6dpfopIQJIiuDlZbcJ9pBzmMzwpllGVQAEAt2XJYsftrb7fe-MszST8O45zanauY0_zZoUEJnbCsOb9-f84taAie9-56gfhxnv2IikaRRW4u-rDX9IkUcO2PpkUD7HqhkYbLY21nJ5aSSJQDCnzcQt_0-_9wYD6SZeAuPhaoN449Rq_L59DCjjugTU1ILvwwy4AZ93Qd0awv65GMGRpsNdtjRVq0Xx88MMzgun5wHOlYDqD6SQoAR2uzdG-O63Ii7NKJQnNdECAdJAY-3xqDz3sGM9L7gWCQoDO9E_Zw685Q0lmen-XZEoEc9yC0aMiJdKb8P-oKDFB25EI0MiH2X6Dwt_VU5neifuxp5Axw8zuo17BgXfi7AwYAVtOrfbUyrOLI3TlOUxiHNw%3D%3D) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

Former Navy SEAL Tim is fighting an uphill battle against a career politician who will spend hundreds of millions to cling to power and continue to work against the interests of the people of Montana.

[**A MESSAGE FROM TULSI GABBARD ->** ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=ee87994de5ae4ef3bd7ba785533e811c&_e=1I_jJKLoG2kj4vPu5THK51TUJmKDT6lIprg7vfFS2gYKjeNdsg4awani3h-o8mqAsvgnFnLzrHSzUWPJNavNJI67e-689tiE8SenqrJxYtbkJ08v8zJ_Y9Ndgd6Gupync4l01ZY8coo-LX81XsvZ8UZFUnhKc_LFdGDlUlV9IVSaFfREHbti-SM1rGtsBzZkDsSaf5OAArWeVy01LUrC1AQYxKhxUvWa1ndpFiJbTGK6Wmymi6lzOHdpZh84KZe6pxW2YThER4Y3szB7kXIO18yIxCsRm7vb-iEWEiBwOUNj6QeGJNbuzpUhgP-FJ-nXYZ20BKO4Z-f1mFr2n3NHzxFyUnT5BFrNNsGe-rjWSZhLgwC40Zo6hZyriq0yBgrEv1W8HliFjconvWT1e3_0Mg%3D%3D)

I knew I had to help, Peter.
_
I was in Montana recently to rally support for Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy as he campaigns to unseat Jon Tester._

When I found out Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy was running for Senate in Montana, I knew I needed to help this decorated warfighter and true patriot defeat the Washington establishment incumbent, Jon Tester.

Fox News is wrong, friend -- big surprise.
The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) isn't about partisanship. It's not about gaming the system. They've spent decades drowning in their own rhetoric and can't understand the simple fact of people choosing a system that's right and just over a system that benefits themselves and harms others.
Fox News is worried about political parties. We're worried about the people's voices being heard and their votes meaning something. We're worried about a system that has rewarded the popular vote loser with the job anyway five times now. We're worried about the people and the states that get ignored and lost along the way to *just enough* Electoral College votes.

| Peter, The Paris Olympics opening ceremony has unveiled a disturbing spectacle—**a stark warning of the moral and spiritual decline gripping our globe.**
Last Friday, the world witnessed a brazen celebration of demonic mockery and LGBTQ extremism. The opening of the Paris Olympics managed to twist a sacred event into an outright spectacle of moral decay. What we witnessed was not merely poor taste; it was a calculated insult to Christian values and a clear signal that spiritual warfare is intensifying. **It was a grotesque mockery of all we hold sacred.
** The inclusion of explicit pagan rituals, drag queens parading as icons of culture, and the exposure of nudity to the world, including innocent children, signals a deep moral collapse. **_THE FIGHT IS NOT COMING, IT'S ALREADY HERE._**
---
|
---
We at the Common Sense Club see this not as mere cultural shift but as **a battle for the soul of our civilization.** These events are not isolated; they are part of a broader, aggressive campaign to dismantle the traditional values that form the backbone of our societies.

[Click here to join the fight.](https://xtz223.keap-link019.com/v2/click/ca6f6dea6ab716a36538ddeff10d0bbb/eJyNkEELgkAQhf_LnE1rNRBvERGieYg6x6JTbum6rGNW4n9vs_BU0Pl97xvedEAouaQwgwBu9GDMBQs0pkIJlLSsJPF0SNncm7kzCwohL2tdNQqC7mt5BIaW5zML6K7QILvtYhmFyfoQh0lkSMW1ufGfZ-5PR89qswhj6PufYiwFra7GXUNAusHXokyYVbTXheFzIlUHjtO2rX2uhKQcj-KUE5syz06r0sGSi2LyioyNK4Uy-7wiwvvb2T8BJLdm9w==) **Together, we will not just resist;_we will prevail._** In defiance and strength, The Common Sense Action Team

Through a series of heartfelt speeches and powerful testimonies, the convention painted a picture of a nation that thrives when we stand together, undivided by the forces seeking to pull us apart. Friend,

Today marks the 59th anniversary of Medicare and Medicaid — two programs that have provided _tens of millions of Americans_ access to affordable health care coverage.
Believe me when I say that _I truly understand the critical role Medicare plays for our seniors._ As my mom's caretaker, it has been my privilege and joy to ensure that she can age with dignity and comfort. There are a lot of big things that come along with that job, from managing her doctors' appointments to advocating for her care.

I care about the people of all ages who make up our nation, friend, and that's why I wrote the plan to expand Medicare while I was in Congress. I worked at the state and national level to expand health care access for Americans and protect our seniors who have worked their entire lives to earn their retirement.
**But extremist Republicans like my opponent, Rick Scott, are working to gut these critical programs. In fact, Rick Scott wrote the plan to defund Medicare — a plan that would increase the number of seniors living in poverty by 40%.**

Friend, my mom is just one of the 65 million people across the United States who relies on Medicare. And if the GOP succeeds in cutting these critical benefits, **she'll be one of _millions_ whose futures will be put at risk.**

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

In September, I took to the House floor to urge political reform and reign in Supreme Court misconduct.

Now, President Biden and Justice Kagan are publicly demanding judicial accountability.

Just this week, President Biden has proposed [https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2024/07/29/joe-biden-reform-supreme-court-presidential-immunity-plan-announcement/] a binding code of ethics, 18-year term limits for Justices, and a constitutional amendment to reverse presidential immunity. And Justice Kagan called for [https://www.politico.com/news/2024/07/25/elena-kagan-supreme-court-ethics-reform-00171317] stronger external ethics enforcement rather than justices policing themselves.

Momentum for Supreme Court reform is building. But I need your help to show Congress that there is widespread popular support for fixing the Supreme Court.

Tell Congress: Hold Supreme Court Justices accountable. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/scotus-reform-petition?contactdata=GVIgksq2S21DXYo1nSgZYtb2P8beyGz+6YFH0oV1XWe+WwM1IR+4TUSOlFOS55ajNABtb8HKmLYzgetTO1OIdKOMi6Hz23t5GreHz1VDCRIQTmq4Y4FvycNzSDu6ty+4BgGfCelBIvMUtCnzZXhDNg==]

https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/1681679497332940801 [https://x.com/RoKhanna/status/1681679497332940801]

The Supreme Court is in a legitimacy crisis. Justices have failed to disclose gifted yacht trips [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2024/06/13/supreme-court-clarence-thomas-travel/], refused to recuse themselves from cases with conflicts of interest [https://www.cnn.com/2024/05/29/politics/alito-flag-controversy-response-supreme-court/index.html], and secretly endorsed returning “our country to a place of godliness.” [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2024/06/10/alito-secret-recordings-politcal-divide/]

70% [https://apnews.com/article/supreme-court-trump-presidential-immunity-abortion-gun-2918d3af5e37e44bbad9c3526506c66d] of American adults believe Justices shape the law to fit their ideologies instead of being fair or impartial and nearly 40% [https://apnews.com/article/supreme-court-trump-presidential-immunity-abortion-gun-2918d3af5e37e44bbad9c3526506c66d] say they have hardly any confidence in the Court at all.

TAKE ACTION: Tell Congress to implement term limits and a binding ethics code for justices. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/scotus-reform-petition?contactdata=GVIgksq2S21DXYo1nSgZYtb2P8beyGz+6YFH0oV1XWe+WwM1IR+4TUSOlFOS55ajNABtb8HKmLYzgetTO1OIdKOMi6Hz23t5GreHz1VDCRIQTmq4Y4FvycNzSDu6ty+4BgGfCelBIvMUtCnzZXhDNg==]

Sign the Petition [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/scotus-reform-petition?contactdata=GVIgksq2S21DXYo1nSgZYtb2P8beyGz+6YFH0oV1XWe+WwM1IR+4TUSOlFOS55ajNABtb8HKmLYzgetTO1OIdKOMi6Hz23t5GreHz1VDCRIQTmq4Y4FvycNzSDu6ty+4BgGfCelBIvMUtCnzZXhDNg==]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

Peter -

But this isn’t new for me. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=7186%2E5257348%2ETEXH0y ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek — The
2024 Olympic games kicked off last week in Paris. And while I’m certainly
not an Olympic-level athlete, I’ve enjoyed playing and watching sports my
whole life.

Before I take you on a trip down memory lane, I have to mention this:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=july2024_abs_em.MnctZF&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240730_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=7186%2E5257348%2ETEXH0y ]I’m in the most important race of my life — this campaign for the U.S.
Senate — and with less than 100 days until we cross the finish line, I’m
hoping you can chip in
$10 to help
me win this November. Derek,
can you pitch in?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em.oAIbuh&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240730_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=7186%2E5257348%2ETEXH0y ]DONATE

Here I am as a kid swinging a baseball bat. I think I’ll leave the
baseball to my GOP opponent, and he can leave the legislating to me.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em.oAIbuh&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240730_AM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=7186%2E5257348%2ETEXH0y ]Adam as a child swinging a bat

Before moving to California, my family lived in Massachusetts, where my
brother and I enjoyed sledding in the backyard.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em.oAIbuh&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240730_AM1_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=7186%2E5257348%2ETEXH0y ]Adam and his brother sledding

When we moved to California, I got really into soccer and played on a
country all-star team.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em.oAIbuh&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240730_AM1_V1_S1&t=1008&akid=7186%2E5257348%2ETEXH0y ]Adam posing in his soccer uniform

I’ve always enjoyed running, done a few triathlons, lots of 5ks, and a
marathon.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em.oAIbuh&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240730_AM1_V1_S1&t=1009&akid=7186%2E5257348%2ETEXH0y ]Adam running in a marathon

Derek,
although I might not be as active as I
used to be, I still enjoy running and going for bike rides with my wife,
Eve. (We met on a tennis court.)

And I’m running for Senate to make sure our children and grandchildren
have access to good schools with extracurricular activities. So they have
clean air to breathe and clean water to drink. So they can pursue their
dreams — whether that’s an Olympic athlete or a member of the U.S. Senate.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em.oAIbuh&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20240730_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1010&akid=7186%2E5257348%2ETEXH0y ]With the 2024 Olympics underway and my July fundraising deadline
rapidly approaching, I’m asking you to join me in this final sprint by
pitching in a grassroots contribution to my campaign.
Derek, can
you join the team today and chip in?
