JULY 30, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

NRCC Slams Peltola, Doubles Down on New Support for Nancy Dahlstrom

ANCHORAGE, AK - The National Republican Congressional Committee (NRCC)
released a new ad, with everyday Alaskans sharing their concerns with
Mary Peltola's rubber stamp loyalty to the Biden-Harris administration.
Watch the full ad here.

<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70807&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=63840> "Supporting him, saying she didn't see any
decline. What was Mary seeing?" One Alaskan asked.

The new ad was released just hours after the NRCC named Lieutenant
Governor Nancy Dahlstrom in the first wave of the NRCC's Young Guns
Program. In the announcement, NRCC Chairman Richard Hudson said
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=70807&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=63841> , "Extreme House Democrats' border, crime
and cost of living crises wrecked Americans' safety and security.
Fortunately, these Republican candidates are already well on their way
to running winning campaigns that will grow our House majority in
November."

Along with earning a spot on the list as a top Republican challenger in
the country, Dahlstrom has been endorsed by President Donald Trump,
Governor Mike Dunleavy, and Speaker Mike Johnson.

Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom responded by saying:

"Mary Peltola has let down Alaskans for far too long and voted with Joe
Biden 80% of the time last year." Dahlstrom went on to say, "This
November, we have an opportunity to help Republicans grow their
majority in the House and send a new Representative to Washington who
can help get the border crisis under control, bring down the cost of
living, and show our state what real leadership looks like."

You’ve probably noticed that children today aren’t getting the same kind of education that you and I received when we were growing up. |
---

If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_s=bc4f16ae1d7b4887bc9417ba87b69289&_t=EaDpMxwot2aRETApvnnYU7xKD6qyABBaGnHcfKQUwDA-41baqBT0aCE97o3kpJ5vn-990w4ToA_RPv0kysYPDM52p0SqGBtWcLEWS62B2fVgWPrJ7ZQBx7e4T_I30YrD)_

| | [](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=bc4f16ae1d7b4887bc9417ba87b69289&_e=g0FbQcYz30Nxv94QKTAHQwrs4n0DoJMlpL56E7gLnc7-T6mESpNbaTScbGC-KmgcdGzzPzHVeDpXid8nM0Lc1Inpm7FCPs63z0q7T6XBjTX5mDWiS5bjZdZrKfh1Dvr398VyNOdrVfB-lTrJf8ox1th5Ji3jPEZcm19PUCjbMdKSLSYsoUVfIFPjsby2A89_6r5_MWbzoCAFZg-jDzBqx2jFF4A5dZyvx-GJVn6LtlBHPjQ6ebMfrgyQNJHiKJjGL7PvatIPLqDSttJaKuvcyEoH8DeDKJA_V7SMDv5_Ne0rrnfP5KBgI3WDpN_0lepeIgcbEIIXwyUfWN7Dl5f-1Nq4kJPtwJ60LJHa1263Pu1U3qOibcsG0p_1LGkyRlLmfrl63z5yvwfZSlw-Pi81pA%3D%3D)
---
| Fellow Patriot,

You've probably noticed that children today aren't getting the same kind of education that you and I received when we were growing up.

We used to be taught to love our nation, cherish our history, and respect our fellow Americans. But all of that has changed.

In today's classroom, children are taught that America is fundamentally racist, that our history is one of oppression, and that we should focus on our differences instead of what unites us.

[](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=bc4f16ae1d7b4887bc9417ba87b69289&_e=g0FbQcYz30Nxv94QKTAHQwrs4n0DoJMlpL56E7gLnc7-T6mESpNbaTScbGC-KmgcdGzzPzHVeDpXid8nM0Lc1Inpm7FCPs63z0q7T6XBjTX5mDWiS5bjZdZrKfh1Dvr398VyNOdrVfB-lTrJf8ox1th5Ji3jPEZcm19PUCjbMdKSLSYsoUVfIFPjsby2A89_6r5_MWbzoCAFZg-jDzBqx2jFF4A5dZyvx-GJVn6LtlBHPjQ6ebMfrgyQNJHiKJjG2k5dq9Prchj5mD4C8lhif5blFjfGyhZCTXNfftR0oYuCVu8Gr8sCqEfc396vWig9gOW6sWfGkc5PTepoSzpd4vNLjCo0cJDY70h6ganlgAG5C7bRjjsFybvgNV9h6RuSkh437GyV6pgZsmIoyOhWBg%3D%3D)
__To make matters worse: the right of parents to choose how and where their kids receive their education remains out of reach for most American families.

And this is exactly why we created our Little Patriots program--to give parents, grandparents, teachers, and caregivers a free online resource they can use to teach children unbiased civics lessons, history, and American values, anywhere and anytime--[completely free of charge.](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=bc4f16ae1d7b4887bc9417ba87b69289&_e=g0FbQcYz30Nxv94QKTAHQwrs4n0DoJMlpL56E7gLnc7-T6mESpNbaTScbGC-KmgcdGzzPzHVeDpXid8nM0Lc1Inpm7FCPs63z0q7T6XBjTX5mDWiS5bjZdZrKfh1Dvr398VyNOdrVfB-lTrJf8ox1th5Ji3jPEZcm19PUCjbMdKSLSYsoUVfIFPjsby2A89_6r5_MWbzoCAFZg-jDzBqx2jFF4A5dZyvx-GJVn6LtlBHPjQ6ebMfrgyQNJHiKJjGqxpbnbajeTWdA9nDzMg9y1AzDelQ1WHjmA8fhV7JrDmrOLz1oFtmkK3jIpOG5r-LH4rN3faoKLM7b3U-QUy7lVvz4XpabS-as76tBwXVKN3019dTEytHAw77m65pDCk9E3-L8d_RRnMZbkHes3wbWQ%3D%3D)

**And now we plan to do even more.**

To meet the growing demand for educational resources that teach children to love their country and its history, we're taking Little Patriots on the road to bring these educational resources to schools, churches, and community organizations!

But to help us fund this coast-to-coast effort, I need your help today.

We depend on the generous support of patriots like you to help us fund this program and share it with children and families across our great nation.

If you believe that American children deserve to receive the best education possible, [can I personally ask you to help me accomplish my goal of getting this first-of-its-kind curriculum to anyone who needs it?](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=bc4f16ae1d7b4887bc9417ba87b69289&_e=g0FbQcYz30Nxv94QKTAHQwrs4n0DoJMlpL56E7gLnc7-T6mESpNbaTScbGC-KmgcdGzzPzHVeDpXid8nM0Lc1Inpm7FCPs63z0q7T6XBjTX5mDWiS5bjZdZrKfh1Dvr398VyNOdrVfB-lTrJf8ox1th5Ji3jPEZcm19PUCjbMdKSLSYsoUVfIFPjsby2A89_6r5_MWbzoCAFZg-jDzBqx2jFF4A5dZyvx-GJVn6LtlBHPjQ6ebMfrgyQNJHiKJjGo5g-rSFcf3lLfrc0vihNgi7OvOSbQc4bFTbW6AZ4eYYTmhv0Yc3E9P2lg5zkoamDdUQSOCrvi4emdxRN8O3L6Ki9Yxy194ZepojRs3tK17eh0Ux0HEr99O-2dvv9kD3FLHigqaGMPpATa3zYSc6-Zg%3D%3D)

If you'd like to help me get Little Patriots to more American children, please click the link below to make your generous tax-deductible gift today:

[**https://secure.americancornerstone.org/little-patriots-tour-donate**](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=bc4f16ae1d7b4887bc9417ba87b69289&_e=g0FbQcYz30Nxv94QKTAHQwrs4n0DoJMlpL56E7gLnc7-T6mESpNbaTScbGC-KmgcdGzzPzHVeDpXid8nM0Lc1Inpm7FCPs63z0q7T6XBjTX5mDWiS5bjZdZrKfh1Dvr398VyNOdrVfB-lTrJf8ox1th5Ji3jPEZcm19PUCjbMdKSLSYsoUVfIFPjsby2A89_6r5_MWbzoCAFZg-jDzBqx2jFF4A5dZyvx-GJVn6LtlBHPjQ6ebMfrgyQNJHiKJjG0YzWvsvlcZwi5J5rVgV82fXKzBBHYy5KpGX2gxGjLVYRRZJgyJHjehukJn__sFEVsBGLMEhT6NUJPnti6UzdUjYfJFywZymddAyjf8w0eEid6yWQsY456LoPeHjtQY9e6njOW8lewNP7g4tgQLvf7g%3D%3D)

Thank you so much for supporting these efforts--[together we can help kids across the U.S. get the education they deserve.](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=bc4f16ae1d7b4887bc9417ba87b69289&_e=g0FbQcYz30Nxv94QKTAHQwrs4n0DoJMlpL56E7gLnc7-T6mESpNbaTScbGC-KmgcdGzzPzHVeDpXid8nM0Lc1Inpm7FCPs63z0q7T6XBjTX5mDWiS5bjZdZrKfh1Dvr398VyNOdrVfB-lTrJf8ox1th5Ji3jPEZcm19PUCjbMdKSLSYsoUVfIFPjsby2A89_6r5_MWbzoCAFZg-jDzBqx2jFF4A5dZyvx-GJVn6LtlBHPjQ6ebMfrgyQNJHiKJjG4NcFZH42yATdMFXQz5b4koQNZ9yOougs5DK30jVroVcgKkdkgSEWEMzDfPcAjUnOBkfEHDZBFCkFC86Va9xe9bAE8w9t-F68Co5B4br5UA0DZIWfuA5kfjm1NZOjKiczdjpsgr8h9_LrvRgu5P4dfQ%3D%3D)

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman

body:
This is Dr. Ben Carson, and I’m writing to you today because your name is on my list of Americans who cherish our nation's guiding values of life, liberty, community, and faith. |
---
| _Please see a special message from our sponsor. | | [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=337c1e8aea28475eb2e6983357ac8018&_e=tuMPxZQZ8fR1_63L2hhN9cC5yxs-Jtn1oC7fwCrhuo3khZrn_1VDdnxPY0SdKOLgw2kZl8sLialFKbnLeZ7cdALoTh7CddJuYtyQKZGeeEYoN8M4EcI5SEanFcaUJByWK41tI7mzGPo007gU5g9lsmKL1xKYjReWzFZb3XKEiMfXL2cdjSvW49BxKwGbz6Zd9n9AAYIIy3KXRsSSCnoa47Ad9YytB5T4IlTD62DFv_rt_CgNGXhLZP8T_m_MkDUP-h-03ZQfOBWILVhKvzV9Les5buOZGpmkQzeDIDlOCVDksXMdMQRo-f2pI6MQyJCaoEStRQIckzmiooMIxz355eqtzl5haAcKnWmfUUCcEkkHYc98fD729GI681twMD0zs3sOZuTTJ8qKc3szb0NZ3w%3D%3D)

| Fellow Patriot,

This is Dr. Ben Carson, and I'm writing to you today because your name is on my list of Americans who cherish our nation's guiding values of life, liberty, community, and faith.

Have you ever stopped to think about how charitable giving is a brilliant reflection of freedom?

It's a way for every American to use our hard-earned money to freely support the causes we care most about.

This is democracy in action: because every dollar you give is a vote for the future you want to see.

I'd like to personally invite you to join me in advancing common-sense solutions to our nation's toughest challenges by [making a generous gift of whatever your budget allows.](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=337c1e8aea28475eb2e6983357ac8018&_e=tuMPxZQZ8fR1_63L2hhN9cC5yxs-Jtn1oC7fwCrhuo3khZrn_1VDdnxPY0SdKOLgw2kZl8sLialFKbnLeZ7cdALoTh7CddJuYtyQKZGeeEYoN8M4EcI5SEanFcaUJByWK41tI7mzGPo007gU5g9lsmKL1xKYjReWzFZb3XKEiMfXL2cdjSvW49BxKwGbz6Zd9n9AAYIIy3KXRsSSCnoa47Ad9YytB5T4IlTD62DFv_rt_CgNGXhLZP8T_m_MkDUPwV8PNwcrBzFhb63o5MuM0jPdHjAEHZh22Sqd9Zz7mZRKGD63F2-nqE0c5ct4ZqG5PNaU76juln_tkYk7VmzRexGooBRtPWkmow0lIqpRlSufvt294KrFjr4zgS_lXGzl4rG78RJhbuizapaV17l5Cw%3D%3D)

Your investment will allow the American Cornerstone Institute to engage in independent research, grassroots outreach, and collaboration with conservative leaders to set forth a better path forward for our country, safeguarding freedom for you and your family in the coming years.

Will you join me? If so, you can support these efforts by clicking the link below:

[https://secure.americancornerstone.org/donate](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=337c1e8aea28475eb2e6983357ac8018&_e=tuMPxZQZ8fR1_63L2hhN9cC5yxs-Jtn1oC7fwCrhuo3khZrn_1VDdnxPY0SdKOLgw2kZl8sLialFKbnLeZ7cdALoTh7CddJuYtyQKZGeeEYoN8M4EcI5SEanFcaUJByWK41tI7mzGPo007gU5g9lsmKL1xKYjReWzFZb3XKEiMfXL2cdjSvW49BxKwGbz6Zd9n9AAYIIy3KXRsSSCnoa47Ad9YytB5T4IlTD62DFv_rt_CgNGXhLZP8T_m_MkDUPZwsYZjn9Ku_SF7P0eZBqjOX34A8z2ohEkBlRzPN9n5kj36KS4Ubz1b8xB4no1KXs-edVFQITIusiHKgjWri6ch_sWfe2ncZX8nI1NzSGKg3PatrSQ0SJ6zmtc645mhyPjB5lcvUs_J1fB9ORjUxvBA%3D%3D)

Where the Left wants bigger government, we'll fight for limited government and self-determination.

America is the greatest country that has ever existed. Please help me do everything possible to make sure it stays that way.

Thank you for your support, Dr. Ben Carson
Founder and Chairman

That’s why I’m asking you to use your grassroots power to make sure that a significant majority of Buckeye Staters turn out and vote to keep him in the U.S. Senate. = Sherrod has run on these issues and won elections in the past, but Ohio has become increasingly challenging for a Democrat to win statewide. Sherrod is one of the most vulnerable senators up for reelection – and Ohio’s race for his seat could decide Senate control. Friend, with Republicans getting millions of dollars from billionaires who pay less in taxes than American workers do, grassroots power is the most effective way to keep Sherrod Brown as our champion in the Senate and ensure that our hopes, our dreams, and our rights are the law of the land. = | | = Thank you so much for being engaged in this fight. Your support really matters. We can do this! Wishing you and your family all the best, – Carole King Carole King is a singer-songwriter, author, and activist. Her distinctions include a Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award, a Kennedy Center Honor, and double-induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. body:
| | |
---
# **July 30th Newsletter**

---
Dear neighbors,
---
| | The 2024 Summer Olympics Games have officially begun in Paris, France! Team USA entered the games with 592 athletes, more than any other country in the world competing during the two-and-a-half-week festival of sport. Even more exciting, 16 exceptional Virginians have qualified to compete in the 2024 Paris Olympic and Paralympic Summer Games, representing our commonwealth on the world stage. As we continue to cheer on our talented athletes, I would be remiss if I did not acknowledge Northern Virginia resident and gold medalist, Torri Huske, and Team USA teammate and silver medalist, Gretchen Walsh, a rising Senior at the University of Virginia, for their impressive finishes in the women's 100-meter butterfly final on Sunday, July 28th. Team USA is already at the top of the medal leaderboard and we hope that they remain there. You can follow along by visiting [olympics.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89866391/488660533/-718972539?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMDBiNTJjZC04YzRlLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VG66tDtW4d8Ux-pWMpyOv0j1eYW0Iy1QUuYpb_F0CBc=&emci=6d67eac3-7d4e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=f00b52cd-8c4e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801). Regardless of the results, Team USA has already given us much to be proud of in the days ahead. Each athlete is worthy of celebration for the dedication, hard work, and pride that they bring to our country. Their commitment to excellence and sportsmanship is unmatched and exemplifies the values we hold dear as Virginians and Americans. As we continue to enjoy the dog days of summer, please find an update from around the 25th District of the Virginia House of Delegates.
---
| |
# **Virginia Military Survivors & Dependents Education Program ****Fully Restored with Additional Funding**
---
| |
---
| | As promised in the last issue of the newsletter, Senate Finance and Appropriations Chair L. Louise Lucas and House Appropriations Chairman Luke E. Torian introduced identical legislation, [House Bill 6004](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89866392/488660534/-2100935565?242+ful+HB6004+pdf&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMDBiNTJjZC04YzRlLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VG66tDtW4d8Ux-pWMpyOv0j1eYW0Iy1QUuYpb_F0CBc=&emci=6d67eac3-7d4e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=f00b52cd-8c4e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801), and [Senate Bill 6012](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89866393/488660535/-2100935565?242+ful+SB6012+pdf&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMDBiNTJjZC04YzRlLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VG66tDtW4d8Ux-pWMpyOv0j1eYW0Iy1QUuYpb_F0CBc=&emci=6d67eac3-7d4e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=f00b52cd-8c4e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801), to repeal changes to the Virginia Military Survivors & Dependents Education Program in the 2024 biennial budget and provide an additional $90 million in funding from Fiscal Year 2024 surplus funding on top of the $40 million previously allocated. As noted in the graphic, the legislation passed with unanimous approval.
---
|
---
| |
# **A Virginia Master of Wine**
---
| | In the 2024 session, I was proud to patron [HJ 392](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89866394/488660536/-2100935565?241+ful+HJ392&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMDBiNTJjZC04YzRlLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VG66tDtW4d8Ux-pWMpyOv0j1eYW0Iy1QUuYpb_F0CBc=&emci=6d67eac3-7d4e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=f00b52cd-8c4e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801), commending Joshua Grainer for attaining the title of Master of Wine from the Institute of Masters of Wine in 2023. Mr. Grainer is managing director and winemaker for [RdV Vineyards](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89866395/488660537/-312515982?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzQ0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMDBiNTJjZC04YzRlLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VG66tDtW4d8Ux-pWMpyOv0j1eYW0Iy1QUuYpb_F0CBc=&emci=6d67eac3-7d4e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=f00b52cd-8c4e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=21796801) in Delaplane, and is the first Virginian to be honored as a Master of Wine and one of only approximately 400 other viticulturists across the world to hold this prestigious title. Congratulations again to Mr. Grainer for the historic achievement, and thank you for your dedication to Virginia farming and wine making.
---
|

| |
# **Retirement of Colonel Jarad Phelps**
---
| |
---
| On August 1st, Lieutenant Colonel Jarad Phelps will retire from the Prince William County Police Department after more than 28 years with the department. He has served as Deputy Chief since November 2019 and briefly acted as Chief of Police after the retirement of Chief Barry Barnard in July 2020. It was a pleasure to attend his retirement celebration and present a commending resolution on behalf of the Prince William County Delegation to the Virginia House of Delegates.
---
| | Even though his retirement is a loss for Prince William County, we are confident in the leadership that remains and wish Lieutenant Colonel Phelps the best in his future endeavors. Below is a brief summary of Lieutenant Colonel Phelps' remarkable career.I'm a new paragraph block.
---
| |
---
Deputy Chief Phelps, a native of Prince William County, joined the police department in 1996 as a patrol officer in the Operations Division. Throughout his career, Deputy Chief Phelps took on various roles and was part of multiple part-time teams within the agency, eventually rising to the rank of lieutenant. In 2014, Phelps was promoted to the rank of Captain and served as an Evening Shift Commander, the Special Operations Bureau Commander, and the Criminal Justice Academy Director. In 2017, Phelps was promoted to Major as an Assistant Chief overseeing the Operations Division during the establishment of a third patrol district. He was named Deputy Chief in 2019 and briefly served as Acting Chief in 2020 during a critical period for law enforcement, which included civil unrest and police reform, as well as the global COVID-19 health pandemic. Deputy Chief Phelps holds a master’s degree from George Mason University and an undergraduate degree from James Madison University. Additionally, he has attended numerous leadership and senior management schools, including the FBI National Academy.

# **Call For Applicants to the Virginia House of Delegates Page Program**
---
| |
---
| The Virginia House of Delegates Page Program is a program for youth focusing on civics education, the lawmaking process, and leadership development. Pages are an integral part of an institution with a long-standing tradition of providing outstanding support and customer service to state legislators and those they represent. Since 1847, this educational program has been helping youth become more engaged citizens and effective leaders. Each year, the Speaker of the House of Delegates appoints 13 and 14 year-olds from across the commonwealth to work in the House Clerk’s Office as House Pages during the Regular Session of the Virginia General Assembly.

clean_body: | | | July 30th Newsletter Dear neighbors, | | The 2024 Summer Olympics Games have officially begun in Paris, France! Team USA entered the games with 592 athletes, more than any other country in the world competing during the two-and-a-half-week festival of sport. Even more exciting, 16 exceptional Virginians have qualified to compete in the 2024 Paris Olympic and Paralympic Summer Games, representing our commonwealth on the world stage. As we continue to cheer on our talented athletes, I would be remiss if I did not acknowledge Northern Virginia resident and gold medalist, Torri Huske, and Team USA teammate and silver medalist, Gretchen Walsh, a rising Senior at the University of Virginia, for their impressive finishes in the women's 100-meter butterfly final on Sunday, July 28th. Team USA is already at the top of the medal leaderboard and we hope that they remain there. You can follow along by visiting . Regardless of the results, Team USA has already given us much to be proud of in the days ahead. Each athlete is worthy of celebration for the dedication, hard work, and pride that they bring to our country. Their commitment to excellence and sportsmanship is unmatched and exemplifies the values we hold dear as Virginians and Americans. As we continue to enjoy the dog days of summer, please find an update from around the 25th District of the Virginia House of Delegates. | | Virginia Military Survivors & Dependents Education Program Fully Restored with Additional Funding | | | | As promised in the last issue of the newsletter, Senate Finance and Appropriations Chair L. Louise Lucas and House Appropriations Chairman Luke E. Torian introduced identical legislation, , and , to repeal changes to the Virginia Military Survivors & Dependents Education Program in the 2024 biennial budget and provide an additional $90 million in funding from Fiscal Year 2024 surplus funding on top of the $40 million previously allocated. As noted in the graphic, the legislation passed with unanimous approval. | | | A Virginia Master of Wine | | In the 2024 session, I was proud to patron , commending Joshua Grainer for attaining the title of Master of Wine from the Institute of Masters of Wine in 2023. Mr. Grainer is managing director and winemaker for in Delaplane, and is the first Virginian to be honored as a Master of Wine and one of only approximately 400 other viticulturists across the world to hold this prestigious title. Congratulations again to Mr. Grainer for the historic achievement, and thank you for your dedication to Virginia farming and wine making. | | | Retirement of Colonel Jarad Phelps | | | On August 1st, Lieutenant Colonel Jarad Phelps will retire from the Prince William County Police Department after more than 28 years with the department. He has served as Deputy Chief since November 2019 and briefly acted as Chief of Police after the retirement of Chief Barry Barnard in July 2020. | | | Elon Musk shared a fake video on his platform X that uses an AI-generated voice mimicking Kamala Harris, calling herself the “ultimate diversity hire” and spewing other insults about her and Joe Biden. Musk’s post does not label the video as parody or include any disclaimer about the AI-generated voice, potentially violating X’s own rules about sharing “misleading media.” Elon Musk has over 190 million followers on X and owns the company. Spreading disinformation is incredibly dangerous – and it’s not the first time he’s done it. We need to condemn it, fight back, and if it continues, change the laws to make this a criminal offense. name: Charlie Kirk, TPUSA
subject: The next generation needs this
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsTZIaEWNk

We're in a moment of national reflection.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osTZIaEWNk

Friend,

We're in
a moment of national reflection.

And for
many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our
culture, institutions, and daily lives-for the better.

Friend,
over the past year, I wrote my new book, Right Wing Revolution,
as a guide for a return to an America where…

We
are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief
in American Greatness.
We
have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our
Constitution.
We
have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide
spiritual renewal.
We
trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have
to lock our doors at night.
We
bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with
integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for
all Americans.

Can I
send you a FREE copy of Right Wing Revolution to read today? All
I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning
Point USA-and our critically important work to make kids LOVE
AMERICA again.

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

Friend,
I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book
you've read from the Right before:

It's
NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between
Left and Right.
It's
NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I
do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.
It's
NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference -
instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our
country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving
ourselves.

I want to
get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as
possible-which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover
edition for FREE.

All I ask
for in return is your gift of ANY amount to help support Turning
Point USA's work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again!

Make
your gift & get your FREE book

In this
defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a
spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to
find all that's possible in the days ahead.

Thank YOU
for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of
Turning Point USA.

For
America,

Charlie
Kirk
Founder &
CEO
Turning
Point USA

Support
Turning Point USA

4940 East
Beverly Road
Phoenix,
Arizona 85044

**_Thank you for joining us each Tuesday for the "Conversations with the Candidate" Zoom event hosted by Women for Campbell. Last week, we were motivated by a discussion featuring Corlette Deveux on elderly care and benefits. We then had an engaging conversation about the breaking news that President Biden will not run for re-election. Additionally, we spoke with Mrs. Cheryl Campbell about the 44,000 women supporting Vice President Kamala Harris and emphasized the importance of voting for Stanley Campbell for U.S. Senate._**
**_This Tuesday, July 30th, we'll be broadcasting our W4C Zoom event live on Facebook. We appreciate the feedback from those who don't want to miss Vice President Harris' speech or the Women for Campbell event. To accommodate both, our team has worked creatively to bring you these two Zoom meetups in one convenient live stream._**
Spotlight Discussion: **SOCIAL JUSTICE**
Subject Matter Expert: **Karen E. Haag MS. LMHC IMH-E Mentor- Clinical**
Karen E. Haag is a practicing licensed Mental Health Counselor and a Clinical and Reflective Supervisor Consultant with expertise in infant and early childhood mental health. She is a Qualified Supervisor in the state of Florida for mental health counseling interns and is trained and rostered in child-parent psychotherapy. For the past 20 years, her work has focused on supporting children and high-risk families from marginalized and migrant communities who have experienced traumatic separation. Haag has served as a clinical director for an evidence-based program that supports children exposed to trauma and toxic stress, working primarily through the juvenile court dependency system and within the local community.
Supported by: Silvia Alvarez McBride: A practicing licensed Mental Health Counselor, Clinical/Reflective Supervisor, Early Childhood Education Coach, and Parenting Facilitator with expertise in infant and early childhood mental health and development. She provides trauma-focused treatment utilizing Child-Parent Psychotherapy and TF-CBT (certified). She is a Qualified Supervisor in the State of Florida for mental health counseling interns and clinical social work interns. Additionally, she is a Certified Breastfeeding Counselor and provides breastfeeding support for new mothers. Silvia is endorsed by the Florida Association Infant Mental Health: IMH-Mentor Clinical.
Our Candidate Mr. Stanley V. Campbell
Stanley Campbell, Democratic candidate for the U.S. Senate is a native Floridian, raised in the Liberty City area of Miami to a Jamaican father who was a lifelong advocate for public schools and a union worker, and a Bahamian mother who was a hairdresser and community organizer. He has dedicated himself to public service through an accomplished career in the U.S Navy (pilot), NASA, Healthcare and Technology, AI and Cyber Security expert. He received his education from the Miami-Dade public school system and furthered his studies at Florida A&M; University (FAMU). At just nineteen years old, while at FAMU, he created the data reduction algorithm and aero analysis for the Voyager 2 spacecraft now in interstellar space.
We close with a note of gratitude; thank you for joining us every Tuesday at 7:00pm on Women for Campbell and thank you to those who have served and continue to serve to protect our freedom in America!

Peter,
What a moment. This past week, we witnessed an incredible burst of energy and enthusiasm. Young voters are registering at historic rates. Volunteers are signing up to engage their communities in record numbers. The excitement going into the fall is palpable.
At All On The Line, we couldn’t be more fired up — though we know there is much work to be done, and this is just the beginning of a vital election season.
With renewed spirit, we remain committed to turning out voters across the country, recruiting poll workers to ensure everyone is able to cast their ballot in a fair and timely manner, and making sure the will of the people is not only heard, but respected and reflected.
The fact of the matter is, how much work we’ll be able to do this season depends in large part on the resources we are able to raise.

clean_body: We are fired up, and we know that this is just the beginning. | Peter, What a moment. This past week, we witnessed an incredible burst of energy and enthusiasm. Young voters are registering at historic rates. Volunteers are signing up to engage their communities in record numbers. The excitement going into the fall is palpable. At All On The Line, we couldn’t be more fired up — though we know there is much work to be done, and this is just the beginning of a vital election season. With renewed spirit, we remain committed to turning out voters across the country, recruiting poll workers to ensure everyone is able to cast their ballot in a fair and timely manner, and making sure the will of the people is not only heard, but respected and reflected. The fact of the matter is, how much work we’ll be able to do this season depends in large part on the resources we are able to raise. Right now, we’re hoping to secure donations from 20 supporters in CA ahead of tomorrow’s monthly fundraising deadline. | | Today marks the 59th anniversary of the establishment of Medicare and Medicaid. Despite decades of American families relying on Medicare and Medicaid for literally life-saving care, my Republican colleagues in Congress consistently release budgets and introduce legislation that undermine these critical programs. **As a long-time advocate for strengthening Social Security and Medicare, I worry about what their proposals would do to the millions of Americans who rely on these programs — especially our seniors.** Social Security and Medicare have served as lifelines, providing essential coverage and financial stability to our aging population, folks with disabilities, and lower-income families for decades. These programs demonstrate our shared commitment to ensuring a dignified life for _all_ , regardless of socioeconomic status. **When it comes to health care, I believe that access to high-quality, affordable care that fits Northwest Washington families' budgets is a right.** And for so many of our most vulnerable, that means utilizing Medicare. That is why I voted to:
* Reduce prescription drug costs by letting Medicare negotiate drug prices;
* Impose a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation;
* Cap the price of insulin at $35 per month;
* Close a longstanding coverage gap in Medicaid that locks 4 million people out nationwide;
* Expand Medicare to cover hearing benefits;
* Lower out-of-pocket costs for Medicare Part D beneficiaries;
* Prevent the privatization of Medicare and ensure stricter accountability for private Medicare Advantage plans

These are common-sense solutions that benefit _everyone_. That is why I voted to: Reduce prescription drug costs by letting Medicare negotiate drug prices; Impose a tax penalty if drug companies increase their prices faster than inflation; Cap the price of insulin at $35 per month; Close a longstanding coverage gap in Medicaid that locks 4 million people out nationwide; Expand Medicare to cover hearing benefits; Lower out-of-pocket costs for Medicare Part D beneficiaries; Prevent the privatization of Medicare and ensure stricter accountability for private Medicare Advantage plans These are common-sense solutions that benefit everyone. = = Undermining these programs would leave vulnerable populations with an uncertain future. Together, we can stop this from becoming a reality. Attempted News Excerpt: some experiences as a candidate.

---
| It has not all been bad, 95% of the parades have been a blast. I have actually had people cheering my name, which has to be for me on the most bizarre things for me. At first, I did not really know how to respond the first time it happened in Blane, Mn. I just wanted to hide, but there was no place to hide in the middle of a street full of people. I tried to respond after with gratitude, I just try to have fun at parades and remember that its mostly for the kids with the opportunity to get In front of a lot of people. The parade in Foley, Mn, actually gave me a chance to meet some of my relatives. As my old man tends not to interact with his family much. last, I had seen any of them I was 16 years old at a family reunion. I remember I spent most of my time skateboarding. Everyone was hanging around listening to Babe play guitar and shooting the shit.

As our momentum grows, we are keeping our team on the phones and doors. Our fundraising momentum must be kept up as well to defeat our establishment-backed opponents who have been nothing but disrespectful to me and tried to erase my decades of work fighting and speaking out for my community. Even worse, they’ve tried to act like this competitive primary doesn’t exist, preventing voters from having a voice. However, the stronger our fundraising numbers are, the stronger the message we send to major super PACs like AIPAC and our big-money opponents. I know Michigan voters do not want the status quo; I have seen and heard this firsthand as I canvassed with my team and met with voters on the street. Folks voting in the primary election have told me that Michiganders want bold, progressive change at the polls. **My opponents say** they have plans to fix Michigan’s 8th District, but I am the only one who has actually done it – serving as the Chief Public Health Advisor in response to the Flint Water Crisis and as someone who has championed equitable and adequate funding for our public school system as President of the Michigan State Board of Education. **My opponents say** they want peace, but I am still the only candidate who has made a call for a ceasefire in Gaza to protect our Palestinian brothers and sisters. **[I am leading a bold movement for change in Michigan, and it's crucial that we keep the momentum of our movement going if we want to create dynamic change in Congress. Even giving $5 will make a massive difference in this election next Tuesday.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89873906/488682947/-1272854636?refcode=0730241WeekFR&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZGQwYWI2MzItOTU0ZS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=9e9Pd0MNTZeuMio8MWnuHH_KyZLp7UuCHXy6wJQSfEw=)** We got this, Dr. Pamela Pugh |
* * *
_I’m Dr. Pamela Pugh, and I’m a Saginaw native running for Congress in Michigan's 8th District. I've spent my career fighting to improve the lives of Michigan residents through public health initiatives, and as the Chief Public Health Advisor for Flint I played a pivotal role in standing alongside Flint residents during the water crisis. As a public servant, I currently serve as the President of the Michigan State Board of Education, a statewide elected position. Congressional recess is here, but just because your representatives are taking a break doesn't mean we are. As your representatives return home, let them know what matters to you--a federal right to abortion in the United States.

[**Peter, reach out to your federal representatives and demand a federal right to abortion!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89874954/488685550/-1586495981?sourceid=1149723&utm_campaign=25emefd-0702aab-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=federallegislation&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMzU3N2RmNS05NTRlLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=avgH9gdhjSwUhBjue2IC2X5-9-SymgHAeFmuC1Ujm0Y=&emci=fcb306ef-954e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=a3577df5-954e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=954237)

Today, on World Day Against Trafficking in Persons, we are reminded of the urgent need to combat the heinous crime of human trafficking. Our campaign is dedicated to implementing strong policies that protect the vulnerable, support law enforcement, and ensure justice for victims. We need leaders who will stand firm against trafficking and work tirelessly to eradicate it from our communities.

# **Why Judicial Reform Matters, and the Importance of Your Vote**
---
|
---
As we gear up for the 2024 elections, it’s crucial to understand the significance of judicial reform and its impact on our democracy. President Biden has taken bold steps to reshape our federal judiciary, appointing diverse, fair-minded judges dedicated to upholding justice and equality. These reforms are essential for maintaining a judicial system that truly serves the American people. Judicial decisions shape every facet of our lives - from reproductive rights to healthcare access, environmental protections, and beyond. A balanced judiciary is crucial for safeguarding these rights. By appointing judges who are committed to the rule of law and civil rights, the Biden administration is protecting the progress we've made and ensuring a fairer future for all. This is why understanding and supporting judicial reform is critical for every voter. Kamala Harris has been a fierce advocate for justice and equality throughout her career. Her extensive legal background and unwavering commitment to these principles make her an indispensable leader in the fight for a fair judiciary. By voting for Harris and the Democratic ticket, you are endorsing a vision of a judicial system that defends the rights of all Americans and guarantees equal justice under the law. The stakes couldn't be higher. Your vote has the power to shape the future of our country. By standing with those who prioritize justice and equality, we can ensure a more equitable America for generations to come. This election is not just about individual candidates; it’s about the values we uphold and the future we want to build.

name: Chuck Hubbard
subject: Peter, I’m the Democrat running against Virginia Foxx
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chuck Hubbard for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ch.email?refcode=onboarding [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ch.email?refcode=onboarding]
Peter,
If we haven’t met before, I’m Chuck Hubbard. I’m a native of northwestern North Carolina who's spent forty years of my career working in local journalism, and I'm also the Democrat running for Congress to unseat Virginia Foxx.
(You may remember her from when she screamed at a reporter to shut up earlier this year [https://thehill.com/homenews/house/4274345-republican-tells-reporter-to-shut-up-johnson-2020-election/] . As a former journalist myself, I took that one personally.)
Chuck Hubbard headshot [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/107748/images/ChuckHeadshot2.jpg]
These mountains have been my home all my life. I've spent most of my adult life working at the local paper my granddaddy built, and I always put my community first—and that's exactly why I made the decision to take a leap and run for this seat. I’m proud to say that I never once let my political beliefs influence my reporting, and in Congress, I’ll take that same mindset, rejecting political theater and focusing on what’s important—improving the lives of the folks back home.
But I’m also running because my opponent, Virginia Foxx, is one of the most dangerous Republicans you may have never heard of.
She’s an ultra-conservative Trump loyalist whose MAGA agenda is too extreme for North Carolina. As Chairwoman of the Committee on Education and the Workforce, she's been the Republican Party's main architect for dismantling public education and workers’ protections as we know it. I've watched her rise to power with a journalists' eye, and I've never once seen her put people before politics, or even before her own ambition.
Peter, I refuse to sit back and watch any longer as Virginia Foxx and Republicans in Congress ignore the needs of our neighbors, only focusing on their extremist social legislation and anti-worker policies. That’s not the North Carolina way, and we have a duty to stand up and fight it—and to stand up and fight for rural voters.
My campaign is going to get out into every single county, and we’re going to do whatever we can to reach every single voter and make sure they know we care, we’re fighting for them, and we value their votes.
But I'll be honest: this isn't going to be easy. If we're going to stand a chance of winning, then I really need your support, Peter. If you’re able to, please consider making a contribution of $25, $50 or anything you can, in support of our campaign's effort to beat Virginia Foxx and flip this district blue. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ch.email?refcode=onboarding]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ch.email?refcode=onboarding]
If we stand together, we’ll have the resources to spread the Democratic message to every corner of my district—we’ll be able to fund a real campaign operation so that I can spend my time knocking doors, turning out and talking with every Democrat and Unaffiliated voter I possibly can! I know it’s an uphill fight, Peter, but I never met anybody who climbed a mountain by not trying.
Chuck Hubbard headshot [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/107748/images/IMG_0462.png] Thanks for standing with me,

There are a lot of compelling reasons to support Sarah’s campaign.
#
There are a lot of compelling reasons to support Sarah McBride’s campaign for Congress, but today we’re sharing three of the biggest ones:
1. **Sarah lives and breathes Delaware.** She loves her home state – when she went away to American University for college, she was already making plans to come back and build her life in her home state. As state senator, she has been a powerful champion for Delawareans and their families, most recently helping to pass a bill guaranteeing paid family and medical leave.

2. **Delaware’s Democratic primary is just six weeks away.** While Sarah is in a strong position right now, we can’t take anything for granted. Sarah is running against a former Republican with a history of challenging LGBTQ+ candidates. Since Sarah would be the first openly trans member of Congress, anti-LGBTQ+ activists will be working hard to defeat her.

3. **Sarah is the strongest candidate to not only win this seat in November, but to get right to work making a difference for the people of Delaware.** Sarah has a proven track record as an effective legislator and she’s ready to bring her solution-oriented attitude to Congress to actually get things done.

The Republican National Committee (RNC) and their presidential nominee, Donald Trump, have recently publicly encouraged the use of mail-in ballots . In private, however, they keep filing lawsuits to limit their use.

Hello,
When my husband Adam Frisch ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, we were the underdogs until the very end.
Adam did not receive any national support. We were heavily out-raised and out-spent by Boebert and her Washington allies.
Ultimately, though, Adam lost in a recount by just 546 votes – the closest race in the entire country.
The worst part is that it wasn’t because we didn’t work hard. Our family, our team, and our volunteers gave it everything we had. We just ran out of money.
In the final weeks of the race, we had to cut back. Right as Boebert was increasing her advertising – right as we _knew_ we were on her heels – we had to pull TV ads, cancel digital buys, and make a lot of hard budget decisions.
Adam might not say it, but I will: If we had had additional resources and been able to fully fund his campaign until the end, Adam would probably be in Congress right now – and Lauren Boebert would be a footnote in a history book.
It’s part of why Adam announced so early that he was running again. We need to make sure that we have the money to build a campaign that can sustain all the way through to November 5, 2024.
But with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this race is a lot harder. The Super PACs are already attacking Adam, and he’s not taking any money from corporate PACs. If he is going to win this critical House seat, Adam needs grassroots donors like you to chip in right now:
[**This was the closest race in the country in 2022. It could be even closer in 2024. Please, will you give $5 or more right now to Adam’s campaign – any amount you can afford will go a long way – and make sure we have the resources to win this critical House seat?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89883495/488712261/1610638071?refcode=em20240730mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=b3319abe-a14e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMzMxOWFiZS1hMTRlLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=PGCWsOHA32wOkGfiLIGZrVL1ZHsyBV4ZOL-aPqtg_ZY=)

Fellow American,

I am in full savage mode this week because the American people deserve answers!

You sent me to DC to fight for you. To fight for this nation. _And that is exactly what I am doing._ I refuse to sit silently while Director Cheatle is full of SH\*\*!

I got her to admit the "colossal failure" of the Secret Service AND that the assassination attempt "was preventable".

_ \*\*And then I introduced a privileged motion to impeach Secret Service Director Kim Cheatle.\*\* _ We have NEVER voted on an impeachment of an inferior civil officer... _but historic times call for historic measures._

To all my colleagues who just sit around and wait for the party to tell them what to do... \*\*take out your pencils and take some notes... this is how it's done.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=18806473.7568.1.f350f5df03c8a06780b6b7b743fd55c6 )

But that's just the problem, Fellow American, the establishment in DC doesn't like when I call out their bull\*\*\*\*.

Over $7 million was spent against me in the primary. _ \*\*We still won by 30 points because I refuse to stop fighting for the American people.\*\* _

Now they're preparing to spend tens of millions against me, to shut me up. To stop me from putting a magnifying glass on everything.

\*\*_I didn't come to play though._\*\*

\*\*_I came to DC to bring the heat – the South Carolina heat._\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=18806473.7569.1.8e4c6fdc79c93ed3da351190cbf18c40 )

They will pull every single card in the book to shut me up, shut me down, and make sure I don't come back to DC. \*\*We can't let it happen.\*\*

\*\*I desperately need any amount today that you can chip in to send me back to Washington, so I can keep delivering results like this for you.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=18806473.7570.1.23fd8bc2776709d5ad3a8a71cee835ca )

I refuse to back down.

Please help me out today.

were “siding with evil.”

Bernie refused to back down in the face of this disgusting smear campaign.

This morning, my campaign released our first major statewide TV ad. This one is personal to me.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0ecfba05-594b-40ec-be09-bbc558b79be7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Growing up, my littlest sister was born with a heart condition. It took just two months for medical bills to bankrupt my family -- we were already living paycheck to paycheck.
Friends, neighbors, people from our community who had no more than we did helped us make it through that time. They passed the plate for us at church, they took my siblings and me into their homes when my parents were at the hospital with my sister, and they brought more food by the house than we could ever hope to eat.
I joined the Marines to honor that community.
But between deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan, I saw our bought-off politicians waging war back home. They used every bit of their power to control how the rest of us live our lives, all while letting their corporate donors strip our communities for parts.
So now, I'm running for Missouri's U.S. Senate seat so that communities like mine and yours finally have a real warrior fighting for them in Washington.
I'm going to rebuild our state and invest in building the next generation of industry right here in America. I'm going to restore reproductive freedom nationwide and finally put people in charge of making decisions about their own bodies, families, and lives. And with your help, I'm going to defeat Josh Hawley and flip Missouri's U.S. Senate seat.
My name is Lucas Kunce, and I'm on a mission to take back power from control-obsessed politicians and put real working people in charge of our country.
**I 'd be so grateful if you could help us get this ad in front of voters by sharing this post with every Missourian you know. **

just 59 years ago, over 65 million people’s lives were completely changed

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89884740/488716832/1561815853?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjUwOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NTU1YjU2Ny1hNTRlLWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wOmJ2zzFMpjqQn1rstT6nYv6I8-m8cVrNJU80RB52qE=&emci=3cbc8f61-a54e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=8555b567-a54e-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=12666102) Peter, 59 years ago, President Johnson officially signed Medicare and Medicaid into law. Now, over 65 million people are enrolled in Medicare. As a pediatrician in Adams County, with 65% of my patients' families on Medicare, I saw firsthand the impact of this legislation on hard-working Coloradans. Yet, securing healthcare remains a struggle for too many Americans. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, it’s
official: we have only one week left to save Rep. Cori Bush’s seat in
Congress from a phony Democratic challenger taking millions from AIPAC and
other far-right megadonor groups.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240730-cb.i-8rQj&refcode=em20240730-35846&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=35846%2E1203867%2EnTiUmp ]Can you rush $5 between Cori’s campaign and Justice
Democrats right NOW to help keep our ads on the air and get out the vote
in this final week before the primary?

At this point, our opponents have spent more than $12 million across
Missouri’s 1st district attacking Cori with lies and making her opponent
out to be something he’s not: a progressive champion for the people of St.
Louis.

Wesley Bell claims he’s a Ferguson activist, but the truth is, he’s the
prosecutor who made broken promises to Michael Brown’s family and the
community of Ferguson to climb the political ladder and then failed to
hold Darren Wilson accountable or create real reform.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240730-cb.i-8rQj&refcode=em20240730-35846&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=35846%2E1203867%2EnTiUmp ]Tweet from Heather Lindsy: The audacity of Wesley Bell claiming he was
a Ferguson activist in his ads while running to unseat OUR Ferguson
activist is just beyond! The BIG money behind his campaign keeps me
donating $3, $15, $30 small amts when I can so the exchange commission
reports show PEOPLE not PACs

But Cori? Cori is the real deal. A nurse, pastor, and community activist,
Cori has the experience in both the St. Louis community and in Congress to
back up the fact that she’s a true champion for working people, criminal
justice reform, and human rights. As Bernie Sanders put it:

“She has lived the struggles regular, everyday people endure and her
mission since being elected is to do the very most for her community —
starting with those who have the very least.”

As we approach the 10th anniversary of Michael Brown’s death at the hands
of police, Cori has released her final ad of this campaign to give
Michael’s family a platform and set the record straight on Bell’s broken
promises. The powerful ad is making waves, as noted by Politico:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240730-cb.i-8rQj&refcode=em20240730-35846&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=35846%2E1203867%2EnTiUmp ]Politico: MO-01 — Democratic Rep. Cori Bush features the father and
sister of Michael Brown, who was killed by a police officer in 2014. “I
feel like he lied to us,” Mike Brown Sr. said of Bush’s primary opponent
Wesley Bell, the St. Louis county prosecutor. “He used my family for
power, and now he’s trying to sell out St. Louis,” he added. ... Justice
Democrats, the progressive group backing Bush, pushes back against
“Republican lies” attacking Bush. ... United Democracy Project, the American
Israel Public Affairs Commitee’s super PAC, says that Bush “has her own
agenda” as “Democrats need to stick together to get things done” in a
closely divided Congress.

If we want to achieve justice and progress for all, we can’t let a liar
and hypocrite like Bell replace one of our fiercest progressive voices in
Congress.

Cori is being dramatically outspent by Republican millionaires and
corporate special interests who want to see Bell defeat her, so we’re
coming to you in this final week of the primary to ask for your
much-needed grassroots support.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240730-cb.i-8rQj&refcode=em20240730-35846&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=35846%2E1203867%2EnTiUmp ]Please pitch in $5 or anything you can afford to fuel
our efforts to get out the vote for Cori before MO-01 voters cast their
ballots next Tuesday.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240730-cb.i-8rQj&refcode=em20240730-35846&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=35846%2E1203867%2EnTiUmp ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

The powerful ad is making waves, as noted by Politico: [ ]Politico: MO-01 — Democratic Rep. Cori Bush features the father and sister of Michael Brown, who was killed by a police officer in 2014. “I feel like he lied to us,” Mike Brown Sr. said of Bush’s primary opponent Wesley Bell, the St. Louis county prosecutor. “He used my family for power, and now he’s trying to sell out St. Louis,” he added. ... Justice Democrats, the progressive group backing Bush, pushes back against “Republican lies” attacking Bush. ... United Democracy Project, the American Israel Public Affairs Commitee’s super PAC, says that Bush “has her own agenda” as “Democrats need to stick together to get things done” in a closely divided Congress. If we want to achieve justice and progress for all, we can’t let a liar and hypocrite like Bell replace one of our fiercest progressive voices in Congress. Can I tell you the story of how I first got involved in politics, Derek?
While serving as the president of Nevada's largest synagogue, I was recruited to run in a competitive House race to help flip a red seat blue. Looking back, it's incredibly fitting that _this_ was my entry point to public service – **because my Judaism is at the very core of my work in the Senate today.**
**In fact, my decision to say "yes" and run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.**
Now, as the third Jewish woman and only former synagogue president in Senate history, I'm proud to serve Nevada and our country. And as we face everything from growing antisemitism to attacks on reproductive freedom to threats to tear down our very democracy, I'm as committed as ever to keep fighting to better this world and make positive change happen. **But I need your help.**
**Mitch McConnell's handpicked candidate is doing everything he can to defeat me, and recent polling shows us neck and neck in the race that experts say will likely decide Senate control. So please, I'm humbly asking:**

name: Wes Moore
subject: We can accomplish so much together
body:
Friend,

Every day I am thrilled to fight for the future our communities deserve, the one we’ve earned. I plan to continue my work building Maryland as the state that serves.

I could never have imagined coming this far without all of you. When a state government shuns political games in favor of investing in its people, then anything can be achieved.

Together we have made record investments where it matters the most: in education, public safety, child care, and housing. By investing in youth now, we can all have a better future with the next generation.

For my team to continue our work, we need support from grassroots donors like you. We set an ambitious goal of $25,000 by July 31. With your support, we can continue to build on our accomplishments, but we need to hit our monthly goals to make that happen. Peter, Principle and precedent, not personnel, should be determining factors in the outcome of any case. Yet too often, this Supreme Court has used its illegitimately constructed majority to overturn rulings that the American people have used to order their lives or to deconstruct our system of justice. **For the good of the nation this must change. ** President Biden’s new proposal to reform the Supreme Court marks a significant step toward ensuring the Court operates as it is intended to — insulated from partisan influence and held to enforceable ethics standards — and, in the Presidential immunity case, reversing one of the most democracy threatening and truly ill conceived decisions in our nation’s history. Eighteen-year term limits for justices, and regularized presidential appointments, are a commonsense — and popularly supported — way forward to restore Americans’ faith in the Supreme Court. **These proposals will ensure justices bend less to partisan winds and special interests and move toward a fair evaluation of the law.** Eric H. Holder, Jr.,
82nd Attorney General of the United States

Hi Friend, it’s Carole King 🎶 and I personally wrote this email.
[**If you already know why we need Elissa Slotkin in the U.S. Senate, click here right now—really, every dollar helps!—and have a great rest of your day!**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240730-2-900&t=3&akid=1709%2E135344%2E1O3BEi)
Elissa is an incredible candidate with a compelling story. You might know that she served three tours in Iraq alongside our military before working in national security under two presidents. But I want to share with you some of our recent conversations in which I learned why being a public servant is personal for Elissa.
After comforting families and survivors of not just one but two school shootings in Michigan (Oxford and Michigan State University), Elissa became even more fierce in her determination to stop the #1 killer of children in the United States: gun violence.
“People protested against seat belts in the 80s,” she told me, “but common sense prevailed, and millions of lives have been saved. We need to get this done!”
We CAN get this done if we elect people like Elissa who aren’t beholden to the gun lobby. People with common sense. People who care.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom but slavery--and the project's main goal is to broadcast this false teaching into every home, including yours. name: April Parrott
subject: Can you help celebrate Neil's Birthday?
body:
This is April Parrott, Neil’s wife. I am so thankful for you – Your encouragement to Neil means so very much! I have a favor to ask. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=a09232c327)
---
| |
---
| Office Addres**s: The address is 118 East Oak Ridge, South Point Shopping Plaza, Suite 1800.**

Hi! This is April Parrott, Neil’s wife. I am so thankful for you – Your encouragement to Neil means so very much!

I have a favor to ask.

Neil’s 54th Birthday is today, Tuesday, July 30th. He asked for three things: help with his campaign, strawberry cake... and many hands to fold letters at the new office in Hagerstown on July 30th from noon til dark!

**One great gift to Neil would be a $54.54 donation today or tomorrow**. We can win this open Congressional seat in 2024 – Help us to get Neil’s positive message out to voters!

Would you be able to donate $54.54 today or any amount ending in 0.54, in honor of his 54th Birthday?
---
| [Donate to help celebrate Neil's Birthday](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=a66fe13e17&e=5a45ee1154 "Donate to help celebrate Neil's Birthday")
---
| | Neil and I have been meeting with voters from Oakland to Ellerslie to Jefferson to Gaithersburg each and every day. It has been an exhausting schedule, but rewarding. (I get tired, but Neil buys me ice cream. That is our deal!)

**To watch Neil interact with people makes my heart smile. **He is sincere, and he cares. This man would make a great Congressman.

If you can fold paper or stick on a stamp, you can give Neil another Birthday Gift! Please join us at the new office tomorrow, July 30, in Hagerstown! (The official office opening will be soon...this is a “soft opening!”) **The address is 118 East Oak Ridge, South Point Shopping Plaza, Suite 1800.**

We will be working from noon until dark – Help for whatever time you can. Stay for 1 hour or 7 hours!
---
| [Donate to help celebrate Neil's Birthday](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=044e33eb4e&e=5a45ee1154 "Donate to help celebrate Neil's Birthday")
---
| [Donate to Bring Common Sense Back to DC](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=1b817f2a6c&e=5a45ee1154 "Donate to Bring Common Sense Back to DC")
---
| We will have **CAKE & CANDLES at 6:30pm** when we sing to Neil. I hope that you will be able to join us, even for a little bit!

Thank you for caring about our country and for DOING something about it! I am proud to be working alongside Neil for this Congressional seat, and I hope to link arms with you as we encourage him on his birthday!

Thank you, and I hope that you have a very nice week!

April Parrott

subject: Upcoming Event with Senator Johnson!
body:
Two weeks and counting - Early Voting Starts Today!
| | | |
---
| Event With Senator Ron Johnson!
---
---
| | |
---|---
I am honored to welcome Senator Johnson to our event at the Madison Club on August 9th!

Working as his District Grassroots Director in the 2022 cycle was a privilege. It gave me a great opportunity to increase my experience in grassroots work across the district!
---
| |
---|---
As we did our part, working tirelessly to ensure the Senator was re-elected, I was reminded of his personal encouragement to me to stay involved, keep fighting, and never back down!

With that advice, I led our team to make sure we knocked every door and made every call we could!

| |
---|---
We had teams of volunteers in every county of the district who were proud to stand up and fight for
Truth and Freedom!

And because we never stopped working towards victory, Senator Johnson received nearly 5,000 more votes than the Republican Congressional Candidate in our district!

And... I got to sign the bus!
| |
---|---
Now, I need your support to ensure that I can work side by side with Senator Johnson to represent each and every one of you and our American values in both the House and Senate!

Senator Johnson has proven himself as one who will not bend under pressure, regardless of the source or veracity of the attack, and I look forward to joining him in DC to fight for you
no matter what!

I look forward to seeing you on August 9th!
|

body:
| | | [ ](www.justinamash.com)
---
Friend, I was honored last week to receive the endorsement of Senator Rand Paul, one of the U.S. Senate's all-time great champions of liberty. [](https://connect.justinamash.com/r?u=TR4WyU-_hMxDN7-StohPW0bg2qMfdKCjGw9f05VMUuTkae9OvFf1PyTtC6Y08LlLoVhNJl2g5QNexJSCiTS1Og&e=3ebc65ae19a1c85b4d26eca84f9aae52&utm_source=justinamash&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_is_a_big_endorsement_3&n=1) In case you missed it, here's what he had to say:
> **Justin Amash and I were elected at the same time and served together in Congress for 10 years. Justin is one of the few we can count on to defend the Constitution, oppose endless war and executive overreach, and stop the weaponization of government. He has been a consistent voice and vote for liberty, and he has my full support. Please contribute to his campaign, and if you live in Michigan, please support him in the Republican primary on Tuesday, August 6.** **—Sen. Rand Paul**
---

Since his first day in office, Rand has been fighting against unconstitutional spying, unauthorized wars, and reckless spending. I know he and other liberty-minded senators need reinforcements, and I can't wait to get started. **But we're in the last stretch of the campaign now, and we still need resources to fully implement our final outreach to primary voters.** **Anything you can give—[$25, $50, $100, $250, or all the way up to a $3,300 primary max](https://connect.justinamash.com/r?u=TR4WyU-_hMxDN7-StohPW0bg2qMfdKCjGw9f05VMUuTkae9OvFf1PyTtC6Y08LlLoVhNJl2g5QNexJSCiTS1Og&e=3ebc65ae19a1c85b4d26eca84f9aae52&utm_source=justinamash&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=this_is_a_big_endorsement_3&n=3)—will help us ensure we're doing everything we can to get our voters to the polls on August 6.** Thank you in advance. Justin Amash

body:
#

Hi there, this is Adam Schiff.
Today, I’m reaching out to ask you to chip in to GIFFORDS PAC. I’ll explain why they deserve your support in a moment, but if you’re ready to give now, [**you can chip in here.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240730-2-subs&t=1&akid=8609%2E3935704%2EYFi3zA)

For years, I’ve worked to get weapons of war off our streets and put an end to the NRA’s corrupt, pervasive power over our government. I’ve been proud to carry the bill to repeal the gun industry’s scandalous level of immunity from liability. And now I’m running for the United States Senate to keep up this important work to make a real difference in saving lives from gun violence.
**I’m incredibly grateful that organizations like GIFFORDS PAC are at the forefront. They are leading the charge to keep our communities safe from gun violence.**
I’m deeply inspired by Gabrielle Giffords, my friend and former colleague who was a victim of gun violence 13 years ago. Since that tragic day, she’s turned her pain and deeply personal experience into action, spearheading the effort to make a difference and pass gun safety legislation that saves lives.
Her organization, GIFFORDS, is one of the groups leading the fight to keep our communities safe. GIFFORDS is working for commonsense solutions to gun violence in all its forms, from mass shootings to gun suicides to community violence.
The team at GIFFORDS has had my back as I’ve advocated for gun safety legislation, and now I’m asking if you can step up today and support them before their important end-of-month fundraising drive comes to an end.
[**Will you make a donation of any amount to GIFFORDS PAC? It all adds up to help fuel the work they do to pass stronger gun laws and support candidates who have the courage to act.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240730-2-subs&t=3&akid=8609%2E3935704%2EYFi3zA)

|

**Had the privilege of joining Representative Tim Cahill in Hampton for the Seacoast’s inaugural 'Beachability' event.**
****
**We gained valuable insights into the challenges our disabled community faces in accessing state parks and beaches.**

|

Or what it’s like to be **raised by a single mother,** keeping your family afloat making just $4 an hour?

Do you know what it’s like to **watch the city shell out _millions_ towards a Trump golf course across the street from you,** _rather than towards struggling and hungry New Yorkers like yourself?_

| For years, TFVC has been advocating for your right to make your vaccination decisions **without coercion or interference** , and to keep them private. Last session, the Texas legislature finally passed bills that helped strengthen those rights when it comes to doctor’s offices, state benefits, schools, and places of work. But, we know that the rollout of these laws is never smooth. Too often Texans find themselves still having to **fight against vaccine discrimination** , and over the last several months, TFVC has highlighted several areas of continued violations. We remain committed to fighting for you, and we’ve created [one central link](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTM1ODI2ODI4NjY1Mjk3OTAwJmM9ZDN4MiZlPTAmYj0xMzQ3MDU1NzI1JmQ9cTNqM3Y5ag==.30o8zo6IzC1IjtDnZbcBJEL0pp_B9mxSB-87NxcPGMI) for you to use to report when you or a loved one is being discriminated against based on vaccination status. Click [here](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTM1ODI2ODI4NjY1Mjk3OTAwJmM9ZDN4MiZlPTAmYj0xMzQ3MDU1NzMyJmQ9bDBwN2kyZQ==.m3DOxIW-id4lIsbkMizUlGYy_JGhdDsrLXfrqsbYSNI) if you have a story to tell! **Your stories** will inform our work during interim hearings and our preparations for the upcoming Legislative Session.

I'm sending one final note to you to express my sincerest gratitude to our team, donors, and supporters for their steadfast support throughout the last 15 months of this campaign. | | Fellow American,
---
I was not alone in my revulsion watching the Olympic Committee's purposeful decision to promote a disgusting, blasphemous reenactment of the Last Supper. I shouldn't be surprised that woke, left-wing propaganda infiltrated what should be a global display of unity through sport, but alas, debauchery is running rampant even beyond America's shores. I wholeheartedly support America's athletes, as well as the followers of Christ representing other nations. It is shameful that France, who is hosting the games, voted in support of allowing biological males to compete against biological females.
The first mission of the Olympic Games is the "promotion of ethics and good governance in sport" — so why is the mockery of Christianity the vessel the Olympic Committee chose to kick off the celebration? Christianity across the world is under attack, in some corners with physical violence, and in others, like Paris, through propaganda. We MUST stand tall and denounce this blasphemous attack on our faith. _**BOYCOTT THE BLASPHEMY—SIGN THE PETITION**_

clean_body: Sign the petition and send a message to the Olympics!!!| | | | | | Fellow American, I was not alone in my revulsion watching the Olympic Committee's purposeful decision to promote a disgusting, blasphemous reenactment of the Last Supper. I shouldn't be surprised that woke, left-wing propaganda infiltrated what should be a global display of unity through sport, but alas, debauchery is running rampant even beyond America's shores. I wholeheartedly support America's athletes, as well as the followers of Christ representing other nations. It is shameful that France, who is hosting the games, voted in support of allowing biological males to compete against biological females. The first mission of the Olympic Games is the "promotion of ethics and good governance in sport" — so why is the mockery of Christianity the vessel the Olympic Committee chose to kick off the celebration? Christianity across the world is under attack, in some corners with physical violence, and in others, like Paris, through propaganda. We MUST stand tall and denounce this blasphemous attack on our faith. BOYCOTT THE BLASPHEMY—SIGN THE PETITION When Target marketed transgender products to kids, I called for a boycott. Tens of thousands of Believers signed the petition and stopped shopping. The result? Headlines like this: "Pride Month backlash hurt Target’s sales. They fell for the first time in six years." body:
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=073024_3&amount=25]
9 & 10 News: Michigan Voting Rights Act advances out of committee [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=073024_3&amount=25]
Team: The Michigan Voting Rights Act is making good progress toward becoming law. This bill:
➜ Guarantees in state law protections previously afforded under the 1965 federal Voting Rights Act.
➜ Establishes a nonpartisan election information database.
➜ Requires some local governments to provide alternate language voting materials.
➜ Allows for curbside voting and other assistive services for disabled voters.
This package of bills will reinforce Michigan’s election system and provide clear pathways for those who feel their voting rights are being infringed to right the wrongs that may have stopped them from voting.
Remember: The recent 8th Federal Circuit Court ruling is one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years . In the eight states impacted by the ruling, voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act.
These new laws, if passed in Michigan, would restore those protections and codify them into state law, regardless of how the Supreme Court eventually rules.
Team: We need to pass these bills in Michigan and expand this movement to other states around the country. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to defend the right to vote and support our work to pass critical pro-voter legislation nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=073024_3&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

Other Amount [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=073024_3&amount=35]
The original Voting Rights Act stands as one of the most important laws ever passed in American history and, even neutered, is still a critical protection against discrimination in our democracy. With certain courts are still trying to dismantle it piece by piece, we need states to act and protect our right to vote.
We're not the only ones who see it this way. “ Passage of a state voting rights act will have an important deterrent effect and enshrine provisions to prevent new violations from occurring in the first instance ,” said Martin Harris of the Legal Defense Fund. “ Enshrining these provisions into law will further strengthen Michigan’s democracy for all voters and ensure that voters of color have robust protections .”
Governors and state legislatures can act to help solve the voting rights crisis . It's up to us to make sure they do their jobs.
Team, we need to spread laws like this around the country, from Arizona to Nevada to Georgia. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to help expand ballot access and make every vote count nationwide! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=073024_3&amount=25]

| Last night in Aurora, our community witnessed an **alarming escalation of violence and unrest**. Groups of Venezuelans took to the streets, blocking traffic and discharging firearms following elections in their home country. Reports indicated assaults, thefts, and even a police car being shot at. This escalation is a **stark reminder****of the dangers** posed by the uncontrolled influx of unvetted individuals into our country. Despite the ongoing debates about asylum and immigration policies, many entering the U.S. are subjected to only minimal vetting, leaving our communities increasingly vulnerable
Moreover, a recent federal memo obtained by the New York Post has exposed a chilling development: members of the violent Venezuelan gang Tren de Aragua have been **given the "green light" to target and open fire on police officers in Denver**.

It's clear that **Jason Crow's current approach to border security is failing to protect our communities**. We need strong leadership and decisive action to address these issues and ensure the safety and security of our neighborhoods. As your Republican nominee for Congress, I am committed to advocating for stricter border controls, improved vetting processes, and the protection of our brave law enforcement officers. **We must act now to secure our future and restore order.**

[13x13x1] [] READ MORE [] [180x150x3] [] 2024-05-07 Judicial Watch Sues California to Force Clean-Up of Voting Rolls [] Source: Judicial Watch [] The National Voter Registration Act requires states to “conduct a general program that makes a reasonable effort to remove” from the official voter rolls “the names of ineligible voters” who have died or changed residence. body:
