Friends ,
It's time to expose the truth about the money behind Jim Jordan.
As one of the top five recipients of private equity money in Congress, Jordan is entirely bought and paid for by venture capital firms, private equity, and big real estate companies.
This is the real reason he consistently votes against the interests of farmers, veterans, and seniors living on Social Security.
No wonder farmers across Ohio and the country banded together to start a grassroots campaign to ensure he didn't become Speaker of the House.
They see what we all see: Jordan is not a leader for the people but a puppet for big money.
I've heard that he often dismisses visitors from the district who have scheduled appointments with him, choosing instead to meet with big funders. He cancels at the last minute, sneaks out the back door, or delegates them to a 20-year-old intern. I would never do that. I will always respect the people who have taken the time and spent the money to come to D.C. to meet with me, so we can solve problems and create solutions together.
Unlike Jordan, my vote can't be bought by special interests. My campaign is powered by grassroots support from people like you who believe in real change and authentic leadership. Together, we can fight back against the influence of big money and ensure our voices are heard in Washington. Contribute today to fuel our campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240730_jordans_donors_link1]
While Jordan caters to his wealthy donors, I'm here to represent you.
I come from the heartland, where I spent my summers working on my uncle’s farm in Gallipolis, Ohio.
I understand the blood, sweat, and tears that go into farming and the struggles our seniors face daily.
We need leaders who will stand up for farmers, protect Social Security, and work tirelessly for the betterment of our communities.
As your next Congresswoman, I promise to be that leader. But I can't do it without your help.
The corporate interests that keep Jim Jordan in power are gearing up to spend a lot of money to make sure their congressional puppet stays in office.
They don’t care that in his 17-year career, he hasn’t passed a single bill.
They don’t care that he votes against working people 97% of the time.
They want Jim Jordan's help to gobble up family farms, undermine the hardworking Americans who feed our country, and slash social programs vital to seniors and veterans.
Jordan's voting record is a minefield of crony capitalism and corporate corruption at its worst. This is a man who's spent his entire congressional career working FOR his corporate donors and AGAINST all of us.
But we can end that when we send him packing in November.
Contribute today to support a campaign dedicated to the people, not the powerful. Let's show Jim Jordan and his ULTRA-MAGA backers that the people of Ohio are ready for a change. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240730_jordans_donors_link2]
Together, we can build an even stronger unstoppable people-centered movement and outperform Jim Jordan's corporate millions. Let's take this fight to Washington and make our voices heard loud and clear.

clean_body: We need every member of this grassroots team to put your support behind this plan. | President Biden just announced a bold new plan to reform the Supreme Court and protect the rule of law: 1. No immunity for crimes a former president committed while in office 2. 18-year term limits for Supreme Court justices — which Attorney General Eric Holder has previously proposed 3. A binding code of conduct for the Supreme Court This announcement could not come at a more critical time for our democracy. A recent poll found that as many as seven in ten Americans think that the U.S. Supreme Court justices are driven by ideology. That’s why Attorney General Holder has long championed similar reforms to strengthen the Supreme Court. Just yesterday, he said: “These proposals will ensure justices bend less to partisan winds and special interests and move toward a fair evaluation of the law.” This reform plan opens the door for major progress — and it’s going to take this grassroots team to see it through. — All On The Line is the grassroots advocacy campaign supported by the National Redistricting Action Fund. I know my team and I have reached out about deadlines like this before, but with early voting already underway in Minnesota, this is a big one.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1260%2E791427%2E1pom7F)
**June 5, 2018.**
Do you remember it? I'll never forget it — that was the day we launched our first campaign for Congress.
The truth is, I had no idea what to expect.
I knew we had a large number of supporters who would be willing to commit the time and hard work needed to run a campaign of that magnitude, but I also knew that one of the biggest challenges we'd face would be funding a winning campaign.
But because of supporters like you, that was never in doubt. We were able to organize and mobilize our movement in Minnesota's 5th district, fighting off unprecedented right-wing attacks and outside spending along the way.
Two years later in 2020 we did it again. And again in 2022.
**Midnight tomorrow.**
That's just over 24 hours from now — our final end-of-month fundraising deadline before primary day on August 13.
I know my team and I have reached out about deadlines like this before, but with early voting already underway in Minnesota, this is a big one.
We need all the resources we can possibly raise in order to fully-fund our grassroots organizing and GOTV efforts over the next two weeks, and the truth is that right now we're pacing short of where we need to be.

That's the amount I'm asking you to contribute right now to stand with our movement, close our fundraising gap, and get the job done.

Arizona is a MUST WIN STATE, and in advance of this important deadline we had to make a difficult decision. Please, let us explain why. As one of our most important supporters, we owe you that much.
The polls show Arizona is one of the most competitive states in the country. Ruben Gallego, a longtime member of VoteVets and a Veteran of the Iraq war, is running against Kari Lake in Arizona’s U.S. Senate campaign.
A race like that is going to cost millions of dollars to win, and believe us: it is critical that Ruben wins. Kari Lake is as dangerous a politician as there is these days, a direct threat to our democracy.
The trouble is, our fundraising just hasn’t been as strong as we anticipated after the events of the last few weeks — weak enough that we’ve had to reconsider some of our commitments. With Ruben under attack we knew we had to defend him, but the money wasn’t in the budget.
This was a difficult decision, but we knew what we needed to do. We greenlit the spend, even though we weren’t sure how we’d cover the cost. VoteVets ran $500,000 in ads in Arizona last month, and we’ve just committed another $800,000 right now, a serious amount.

Less than **one minute** , friend.

That’s how long Donald Trump lasted in his recent sit-down Fox interview before talking about me.

This is the same guy calling for “unity” and toning down the rhetoric.

When has he _ever_ toned it down? [**Before I show you what Trump said, rush a split $10 donation to Fight for Reform to elect state and local Democrats and my campaign to help me respond and win this Senate race. Trump’s dangerous rhetoric has stoked hate and division in our political system over and over again.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/47626?t=7&akid=21795%2E4449941%2ErQWM_m) [ ](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/47626?t=8&akid=21795%2E4449941%2ErQWM_m) _“It’s a vicious business, politics. I used to think business was worse.**After about two months of dealing with crazy lunatic Adam Schiff** and these people. They’re just **liars**. They’re **horrible liars**. We’ve dealt with so many **sick, deranged people** that are not **stupid people** , but they’re **deranged people**.”_ Donald Trump’s rhetoric is dangerous. I have been sounding that alarm since his first campaign. And it will only be magnified by the Republican National Convention and his legions of online MAGA supporters.

He resents truth-tellers. Public servants. And anyone who dares to hold him to account.

He admires autocrats in other countries and has repeatedly broken the democratic guardrails we have in place so no president can abuse their office.

**That is why he loathes me — because I investigated him, led his impeachment trial, and investigated his abuses of power on the January 6 Committee. And no matter how he tries to threaten or intimidate me, I will never back down.** [**Your split $10 of support today between Fight for Reform, to help them elect state and local Democrats, and my campaign will help me win this Senate race and continue to hold Trump to account. We must defeat him in November. Trump’s vicious brand of autocratic politics has no place in our country.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/47626?t=9&akid=21795%2E4449941%2ErQWM_m) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Adam Schiff will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/47627?t=10&akid=21795%2E4449941%2ErQWM_m)

Adam

# A Day That Changed Our Lives
---
| Exactly one year ago today, I filled this storage unit with all of my possessions. I gave up my housing to save up as much as I couldso that I could quit my job and run for office.
When I closed and locked that storage door, I was both excited and nervous for what was to come and how my life was about to change.
I stepped up to run against my opponent precisely because I know that when I push myself, I am capable of overcoming anything.
There was that time I jumped out of an airplane, despite my fear of heights.
---
| Or that time I finally got certified to scuba dive, despite being claustrophobic.
---
| Time after time, as I have tested my own limits, I have learned that we can overcome scary things if we set our heart and mind to it.
I have set my heart and mind on giving our districta public servant who is willing to help, listen, and compromise. **Texas and our beautiful planet are too big of places****for small minds and small ideas.**
Because of your help, I know that I am not running this race alone, and **I am deeply grateful for your support in this fight!**
We only have 98 days left to go, so please [**Chip in to get Chip out!**](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=efd1741ee6&e=395a33a3d2)****
Now let’s go out and win this!

Debbie grew up in a one room apartment, and her mother — an immigrant from Ecuador — worked tirelessly to provide a better life for Debbie and her sisters, so they could achieve their American dream. I grew up with six brothers and sisters in a two room house in Jacksonville. My mom worked as a maid, and my dad was a janitor. We both know what it means to work hard and persevere.

Debbie and I also grew up working minimum wage jobs, and yet we went on to serve in Congress together. We've dedicated our careers to public service because we want every Floridian to have the opportunities we had — to ensure the American dream is within reach for _each and every one of them._
But do you know who is standing in the way of the American dream for far too many Floridians? Our extremist Senator, Rick Scott, who is beholden to a disgraced, twice-impeached former president, Donald Trump.

A mere 35% of Floridians view Rick Scott favorably, friend. It's no wonder why. **But Scott spent $64 million of his personal fortune to buy this Senate seat in 2018, and he's already spent millions this time around in his efforts to repeat history.**

Experts everywhere are saying this will be one of the most competitive — _and expensive_ — races in the country.
